[reaction]你在显现效果期间的技能检定成功后，横置佩妮·怀特：发现你所在地点的1个线索。
cards.textEn:
You get +1 [willpower].
[reaction] After you succeed at a skill test during a revelation effect, exhaust Penny White: Discover 1 clue at your location.

cards.name: Valentino Rivas
cards.text:
你得到+1[agility]。
[free]在你执行的技能检定期间，花费2资源并横置瓦伦蒂诺·里瓦斯：本次检定难度降低1点。
cards.textEn:
You get +1 [agility].
[fast] During a skill test you are performing, spend 2 resources and exhaust Valentino Rivas: Reduce the difficulty of this test by 1.

cards.name: Gavriella's Fate
cards.text:
检查剧本日志的“失踪人口”区域。如果加弗瑞拉消失在迷雾之中并且调查员正在追查加弗瑞拉：
加弗瑞拉从雾中跌出，眼睛血红，紧张地说：“我在哪？……你是谁？”
控制放在一边的加弗瑞拉·米兹拉克剧情支援卡。她不占用盟友槽，直到本场冒险结束。在“失踪人员”的加弗瑞拉·米兹拉克旁边记录加弗瑞拉还活着。如果加弗瑞拉已被幽灵夺走性命：
将本卡牌翻回敌人面，将其生成在你所在地点。如果调查员正在追查加弗瑞拉，其生成时被横置并且不处于交战状态。否则，其生成时与你交战。否则：
你发现加弗瑞拉的武器落在草丛里，已经腐坏、破烂。而她本人不见踪影。
cards.textEn:
Check the "Missing Persons" section of the Campaign Log. If Gavriella disappeared into the mist and you are on Gavriella's trail:
Gavriella stumbles out of the mist, her eyes bloodshot and her voice strained. "Where am I?… Who are you?"
Take control of the set-aside Gavriella Mizrah story asset. For the remainder of this scenario, she does not take up an ally slot. Next to Gavriella Mizrah's profile, record Gavriella is alive.If Gavriella was claimed by specters:
Flip this card to its enemy side and spawn it at your location. If you are on Gavriella's trail, it spawns exhausted and unengaged. Otherwise, it spawns engaged with you.Otherwise:
You find Gavriella's weapon lying in the grass, decayed and broken. No other sign of her can be seen.

cards.name: Gavriella Mizrah
cards.text:
警戒。猎手。
强制 - 在你成功攻击加弗瑞拉·米兹拉克后，如果她处于重整状态：受到1点恐惧。
cards.textEn:
Alert. Hunter.
Forced - After you successfully attack Gavriella Mizrah, if she is ready: Take 1 horror.

cards.name: Jerome's Fate
cards.text:
检查剧本日志的“失踪人口”区域。如果杰罗姆消失在迷雾之中并且调查员正在追查杰罗姆：
杰罗姆从雾中爬出，你扶着他起身。“我的天啊……那雾……”他低声说道，“一切都有联系……一切都有联系……”
控制放在一边的杰罗姆·戴维斯剧情支援卡。他不占用盟友槽，直到本场冒险结束。在“失踪人员”的杰罗姆·戴维斯旁边记录杰罗姆还活着。如果杰罗姆已被幽灵夺走性命：
将本卡牌翻回敌人面，将其生成在你所在地点。如果调查员正在追查杰罗姆，其生成时被横置并且不处于交战状态。否则，其生成时与你交战。否则：
你从地上找到了一张来自杰罗姆随身笔记的纸片。上面只写着两个字：“救命！”
cards.textEn:
Check the "Missing Persons" section of the Campaign Log. If Jerome disappeared into the mist and you are on Jerome's trail:
Jerome crawls out of the mist, and you help him to his feet. "Oh god… the mist…" he whispers. "It's all connected… It's all connected…"
Take control of the set-aside Jerome Davids story asset. For the remainder of this scenario, he does not take up an ally slot. Next to Jerome Davids's profile, record Jerome is alive.If Jerome was claimed by specters:
Flip this card to its enemy side and spawn it at your location. If you are on Jerome's trail, it spawns exhausted and unengaged. Otherwise, it spawns engaged with you.Otherwise:
You find a scrap of paper from Jerome's pocket notebook on the ground. It simply reads: "HELP"

cards.name: Jerome Davids
cards.text:
猎手。
强制 - 在杰罗姆·戴维斯与你交战后：选择并弃掉你2张手牌。
cards.textEn:
Hunter.
Forced - After Jerome Davids engages you: Choose and discard 2 cards from your hand.

cards.name: Penny's Fate
cards.text:
检查剧本日志的“失踪人口”区域。如果佩妮消失在迷雾之中并且调查员正在追查佩妮：
佩妮险些把你撞了个满怀。你护着她的时候，她全身都在颤抖。“你、你活着吗？”她哭着说，“噩梦终于结束了吗？”
控制放在一边的佩妮·怀特剧情支援卡。她不占用盟友槽，直到本场冒险结束。在“失踪人员”的佩妮·怀特旁边记录佩妮还活着。如果佩妮已被幽灵夺走性命：
将本卡牌翻回敌人面，将其生成在你所在地点。如果调查员正在追查佩妮，其生成时被横置并且不处于交战状态。否则，其生成时与你交战。否则：
你在地上发现了佩妮的围裙，被血液染红，而她本人不见踪影。
cards.textEn:
Check the "Missing Persons" section of the Campaign Log. If Penny disappeared into the mist and you are on Penny's trail:
Penny nearly runs directly into you. Her whole body shakes with panic as you hold her safe. "A-are you alive?" she cries. "Is this nightmare finally over?"
Take control of the set-aside Penny White story asset. For the remainder of this scenario, she does not take up an ally slot. Next to Penny White's profile, record Penny is alive.If Penny was claimed by specters:
Flip this card to its enemy side and spawn it at your location. If you are on Penny's trail, it spawns exhausted and unengaged. Otherwise, it spawns engaged with you.Otherwise:
You find Penny's apron lying on the ground, covered in blood. There is no other sign of her.

cards.name: Penny White
cards.text:
猎手。
强制 - 在你成功躲避佩妮·怀特后：受到1点伤害。
cards.textEn:
Hunter.
Forced - After you successfully evade Penny White: Take 1 damage.

cards.name: Valentino's Fate
cards.text:
检查剧本日志的“失踪人口”区域。如果瓦伦蒂诺消失在迷雾之中并且调查员正在追查瓦伦蒂诺：
瓦伦蒂诺一瘸一拐地走出迷雾，倚在附近一棵树上。他发现你时，发出了病态的笑声。“救兵终于来了，对吗？”
控制放在一边的瓦伦蒂诺·里瓦斯剧情支持卡。他不占用盟友槽，直到本场冒险结束。在“失踪人员”的瓦伦蒂诺·里瓦斯旁边记录瓦伦蒂诺还活着。如果瓦伦蒂诺已被幽灵夺走性命：
将本卡牌翻回敌人面，将其生成在你所在地点。如果调查员正在追查瓦伦蒂诺，其生成时被横置并且不处于交战状态。否则，其生成时与你交战。否则：
瓦伦蒂诺的手杖落在淤泥里，几乎断成两半。手杖把手沾着陈旧的血迹。
cards.textEn:
Check the "Missing Persons" section of the Campaign Log. If Valentino disappeared into the mist and you are on Valentino's trail:
Valentino limps out of the mist, leaning on a nearby tree. He chuckles morbidly as he spots you. "Cavalry's finally here, eh?"
Take control of the set-aside Valentino Rivas story asset. For the remainder of this scenario, he does not take up an ally slot. Next to Valentino Rivas's profile, record Valentino is alive.If Valentino was claimed by specters:
Flip this card to its enemy side and spawn it at your location. If you are on Valentino's trail, it spawns exhausted and unengaged. Otherwise, it spawns engaged with you.Otherwise:
Valentino's cane lies in the mud, cracked nearly in half. Its handle is stained with old blood.

cards.name: Valentino Rivas
cards.text:
猎手。反击。
强制 - 在瓦伦蒂诺·里瓦斯与你交战后：失去2个资源。
cards.textEn:
Hunter. Retaliate.
Forced - After Valentino Rivas engages you: Lose 2 resources.

cards.name: Whippoorwill
cards.text:
冷漠。猎手。
夜鹰所在地点的调查员得到-1[willpower]、-1[intellect]、-1[combat]和-1[agility]。
cards.textEn:
Aloof. Hunter.
Each investigator at Whippoorwill's location gets -1 [willpower], -1 [intellect], -1 [combat], and -1 [agility].

cards.name: Spectral Raven
cards.text:
猎物 - [intellect]最低。
警戒。猎手。反击。
强制 - 在幽灵乌鸦与你交战后：你必须结算你所在地点的每个闹鬼能力，或幽灵乌鸦得到得+2攻击和+2躲避直到调查阶段结束。
cards.textEn:
Prey - Lowest [intellect].
Alert. Hunter. Retaliate.
Forced - After Spectral Raven engages you: You must either resolve each haunted ability on your location, or Spectral Raven gets +2 fight and +2 evade until the end of the investigation phase.

cards.name: Eager for Death
cards.text: 显现 - 检定[willpower](2)。你每有1点伤害，本次技能检定难度提升1点。如果你检定失败，受到2点恐惧。
cards.textEn: Revelation - Test [willpower] (2). Increase this skill test's difficulty by 1 for each damage on you. If you fail, take 2 horror.

cards.name: Psychopomp's Song
cards.text:
涌动。险境。
显现 - 将灵魂之歌加入到任意调查员的威胁区域。
强制 - 在你将要受到伤害时：受到额外2点伤害并弃掉灵魂之歌。
cards.textEn:
Surge. Peril.
Revelation - Add Psychopomp's Song to any investigator's threat area.
Forced - When you would take 1 or more damage: Take 2 additional damage and discard Psychopomp's Song.

cards.name: Death Approaches
cards.text:
涌动。险境。
显现 - 将死期临近加入到任意调查员的威胁区域。
强制 - 在你将要受到至少1点恐惧时：受到额外2点恐惧，弃掉死期临近。
cards.textEn:
Surge. Peril.
Revelation - Add Death Approaches to any investigator's threat area.
Forced - When you would take 1 or more horror: Take 2 additional horror and discard Death Approaches.

cards.name: Marked for Death
cards.text: 显现 - 检定[agility](2)。你身上每有1点恐惧，本次技能检定难度提升1点。如果你检定失败，受到2点伤害。
cards.textEn: Revelation - Test [agility] (2). Increase this skill test's difficulty by 1 for each horror on you. If you fail, take 2 damage.

cards.name: Watcher's Gaze
cards.text: 显现 - 每位调查员检定[willpower](5)。每位检定失败的调查员必须结算其所在地点的闹鬼能力，或结算幽灵看守人所在地点的闹鬼能力。
cards.textEn: Revelation - Each investigator tests [willpower] (5). Each investigator who fails must resolve either the haunted ability on his or her location, or the haunted ability on The Spectral Watcher's location.

cards.name: In the Clutches of Chaos
cards.text:
简单/普通
[skull]：-X。X为你所在地点的裂口和毁灭标记总数。
[cultist]：再揭示1个标记。如果你所在地点的裂口少于3个，在其上放置1个裂口。
[tablet]：-2。你检定失败且每低于难度1点，移除当前场景上的1个裂口。
[elder_thing]：-3。如果你检定失败，在随机1个地点上放置1个裂口。
cards.textEn:
Easy / Standard
[skull]: -X. X is the total amount of doom and breaches on your location.
[cultist]: Reveal another token. If there are fewer than 3 breaches on your location, place 1 breach on your location.
[tablet]: -2. For each point you fail by, remove 1 breach from the current act.
[elder_thing]: -3. If you fail, place 1 breach on a random location.

cards.name: THE CHARIOT · VII
cards.backText:
检查剧本日志。
- 如果安妮特·梅森被魔鬼附身，(→结局3)。
- 如果卡尔·桑福德知晓了宇宙之秘，(→结局4)。
cards.text:
强制 - 在毁灭标记将要放到本密谋上时：改为在数量等于调查员人数+1的随机不同地点上放置1个裂口。
强制 - 在裂口标记将要放到带有3个裂口的地点时：改为结算该地点的入侵一次。
cards.textEn:
Forced - When doom would be placed on this agenda: Instead, place 1 breach on a number of different random locations equal to 1 more than the number of investigators.
Forced - When a breach would be placed on a location with 3 breaches: Instead, resolve an incursion at that location.

cards.name: Chaos Manifest
cards.text: 显现 - 检定[willpower](3)。在X个不同的随机地点上放置1个裂口，其中X为你检定失败且低于检定难度的点数。
cards.textEn: Revelation - Test [willpower] (3). Place 1 breach on X different random locations, where X is the amount by which you failed.

cards.name: Primordial Gateway
cards.text:
显现 - 附属到一个随机地点。在所附属地点上放置裂口，直至该地点上有正好3个裂口。
将所附属地点的印刷文本框视为如同空白(除[[特性]]外)。
[action]：检定[intellect]或[willpower](4)以关闭通道。如果你成功，弃掉元初通道。
cards.textEn:
Revelation - Attach to a random location. Place breaches on attached location until there are exactly 3 breaches on it.
Treat the attached location as if its printed text box were blank (except for [[Traits]]).
[action]: Test [intellect] or [willpower] (4) to close the gateway. If you succeed, discard Primordial Gateway.

cards.name: Terror Unleashed
cards.text: 显现 - 如果你所在地点没有裂口，在其上放置1个裂口。你必须受到X点伤害或恐惧，由你自行分配，其中X为你所在地点上的裂口和毁灭标记总数。
cards.textEn: Revelation - If there are no breaches on your location, place 1 breach on your location. You must take X damage or horror, divided as you wish. X is the total amount of doom and breaches on your location.

cards.name: Before the Black Throne
cards.text:
简单/普通
[skull]：-X。X为阿撒托斯上毁灭标记数量的一半(向上取整)，至少为2。
[cultist]：再揭示1个标记。如果你检定失败，查找遭遇牌库和遭遇弃牌堆，找出一张[[异教徒]]敌人，并将其抽取。混洗遭遇牌库。
[tablet]：-2。如果你检定失败，阿撒托斯攻击你。
[elder_thing]：-4。如果你本次检定经过修正后的技能值为0，在阿撒托斯上放置1个毁灭标记。
cards.textEn:
Easy / Standard
[skull]: -X. X is half of the doom on Azathoth (rounded up), to a minimum of 2.
[cultist]: Reveal another token. If you fail, search the encounter deck and discard pile for a [[Cultist]] enemy and draw it. Shuffle the encounter deck.
[tablet]: -2. If you fail, Azathoth attacks you.
[elder_thing]: -4. If your modified skill value for this test is 0, place 1 doom on Azathoth.

cards.name: WHEEL OF FORTUNE · X
cards.backText:
每个[[异教徒]]敌人为仪式而自决。弃掉场上每个[[异教徒]]敌人，并将他们的所有毁灭标记移动到阿撒托斯。
调查员队长必须查找遭遇牌库和遭遇弃牌堆，找出一张魔鬼的笛声并将其抽取。
通往你目的地的一路上全是无尽的步道和黑色石阶。这是一个无法走出的迷宫。
检查剧本日志。如果“遗留记忆”下方列有吉尔曼的日记，你可以找到出路。否则，你绝望地迷路了；每位调查员必须移动到其左方的地点，或将其地点向左移动一次(在其原来的位置放置一个虚空格子)。地点不能通过本效果移动超过一次。
cards.text:
每个地点与其相邻的每个地点相互连接。
在本密谋推进时，不要移除敌人的毁灭标记。
cards.textEn:
Each location is connected to each location adjacent to it.
Do not remove doom from enemies when this agenda advances.

cards.name: It Awaits
cards.backText:
每个[[异教徒]]敌人为仪式而自决。弃掉场上每个[[异教徒]]敌人，并将他们的所有毁灭标记移动到阿撒托斯。
调查员队长必须查找遭遇牌库和遭遇弃牌堆，找出一张魔鬼的笛声并将其抽取。
在这超越时间之外的遗忘之地，一切都不复原样。云雾在你周围飞舞翻腾。远处传来的笑声嘲笑着你，黑色星云里出现了一道熟悉的鬼魂——一个早已死去的人。
检查剧本日志。如果“遗留记忆”下方列有磨损的十字架，鬼魂认得你从沃尔特·吉尔曼房间偷来的十字架，缓缓后退，遁入彼端的黑暗之中。
否则，鬼魂攻击你；每位调查员必须检定[willpower](4)。每位检定失败的调查员受到1点伤害和1点恐惧。
cards.text:
每个地点与其相邻的每个地点相互连接。
在本密谋推进时，不要移除敌人的毁灭标记。
cards.textEn:
Each location is connected to each location adjacent to it.
Do not remove doom from enemies when this agenda advances.

cards.name: The Final Countdown
cards.backText:
每个[[异教徒]]敌人为仪式而自决。弃掉场上每个[[异教徒]]敌人，并将他们的所有毁灭标记移动到阿撒托斯。
调查员队长必须查找遭遇牌库和遭遇弃牌堆，找出一张魔鬼的笛声并将其抽取。
密谋牌库不复存在，但本场冒险没有结束。直到本场冒险结束，将要放到当前密谋上的毁灭标记，改为放到阿撒托斯上，且场上所有毁灭标记视为在阿撒托斯上。
你遇到另一伙阿撒托斯的崇拜者，一个无形的兜帽者带领着他们，将一盏古老的提灯高举过头。提灯黯淡的灰色光芒根本无法照亮这个国度的黑暗。不知为何，你觉得那幽灵很是熟悉；某种说不清的亲切感驱使着你前进。
检查剧本日志。如果“遗留记忆”下方列有玉米皮娃娃，那幽灵也认出了你。它好奇地盯着你看，周围一圈信徒停止了祈祷；移除阿撒托斯的1个毁灭标记。否则，那幽灵几乎没有注意到你，周围一圈祈祷者继续咏唱。
cards.text:
每个地点与其相邻的每个地点相互连接。
在本密谋推进时，不要移除敌人的毁灭标记。 (注意——在本密谋推进时，本场冒险不会结束，但世界末日即将到来。)
cards.textEn:
Each location is connected to each location adjacent to it.
Do not remove doom from enemies when this agenda advances. (Beware - the scenario will not end when this agenda advances, but the doom of the world will be close at hand.)

cards.name: The Cosmos Beckons
cards.backText:
将宇宙入口从游戏中移除。将每个虚空格子的卡牌洗入其所有者牌库，将场上除憎恶宫殿以外的所有地点洗入“宇宙”。(FAQ，v1.7)位于这些地点的所有调查员被抛弃并阵亡。将这些地点的每个敌人与遭遇牌库顶的5张卡牌一同混洗，放到遭遇牌库顶。
拿取放在一边的旧日支配者皇廷和“宇宙”顶上的2张卡牌，将其混洗至无法分辨。然后，将这3张卡牌与虚空格子一同放置入场，如剧本手册中“场景2的地点摆放位置”所示。
按玩家顺序，每位调查员抽取遭遇牌库顶1张卡牌。
cards.text:
[action]花费X个线索：抽取“宇宙”顶上的X张卡牌。选择其中一张卡牌，按照其“宇宙 -”指示放置入场，并移动到其上。将其余卡牌洗回“宇宙”。
目标 - 只有憎恶宫殿的调查员可以共同花费所需数量的线索以推进场景。(注意——不位于该处的所有调查员将会阵亡。)
cards.textEn:
[action] Spend X clues: Draw the top X cards of the Cosmos. Choose one to put into play using its "Cosmos -" instructions, and move to it. Shuffle the rest back into the Cosmos.
Objective - Only investigators at Hideous Palace may spend the requisite number of clues, as a group, to advance. (Beware - any investigator who is not there will be killed.)

cards.name: In Azathoth's Domain
cards.backText:
将憎恶宫殿从游戏中移除。将每个虚空格子的卡牌洗入其所有者牌库，将场上除旧日支配者皇廷以外的所有地点洗入“宇宙”。(FAQ，v1.7)位于这些地点的所有调查员被抛弃并阵亡。将这些地点的每个敌人与遭遇牌库顶的5张卡牌一同混洗，放到遭遇牌库顶。
拿取放在一边的黑色王座和“宇宙”顶上的3张卡牌，将其混洗至无法分辨。然后，将这4张卡牌与虚空格子一同放置入场，如剧本手册中“场景3的地点摆放位置”所示。
按玩家顺序，每位调查员抽取遭遇牌库顶1张卡牌。
cards.text:
[action]花费X个线索：抽取“宇宙”顶上的X张卡牌。选择其中一张卡牌，按照其“宇宙 -”指示放置入场，并移动到其上。将其余卡牌洗回“宇宙”。
目标 - 只有旧日支配者皇廷的调查员可以共同花费所需数量的线索以推进场景。(注意——不位于该处的所有调查员将会阵亡。)
cards.textEn:
[action] Spend X clues: Draw the top X cards of the Cosmos. Choose one to put into play using its "Cosmos -" instructions, and move to it. Shuffle the rest back into the Cosmos.
Objective - Only investigators at Court of the Great Old Ones may spend the requisite number of clues, as a group, to advance. (Beware - any investigator who is not there will be killed.)

cards.name: What Must Be Done
cards.backText:
检查剧本日志。
- 如果达成下方至少2种情况，你可以前往(→结局2)：你接受了自己的命运、“遗留记忆”下方列有催眠长笛、“遗留记忆”下方列有仪式道具。
- 如果达成下方至少2种情况，你可以前往(→结局3)：你拒绝了自己的命运、“遗留记忆”下方列有残影碎片、“遗留记忆”下方列有一缕鬼灵迷雾。
- 否则，(→结局4)。
cards.text:
[action]花费X个线索：抽取“宇宙”顶上的X张卡牌。选择其中一张卡牌，按照其“宇宙 -”指示放置入场，并移动到其上。将其余卡牌洗回“宇宙”。
目标 - 如果调查员队长位于黑色王座，且该地点上没有线索，推进场景。
cards.textEn:
[action] Spend X clues: Draw the top X cards of the Cosmos. Choose one to put into play using its "Cosmos -" instructions, and move to it. Shuffle the rest back into the Cosmos.
Objective - If the lead investigator is at The Black Throne and there are no clues on it, advance.

cards.name: Court of the Great Old Ones
Mindless Dancer
cards.text:
生成 - 最远的虚空格子。
猎手。
盲目舞者可以进入虚空格子，如同其进入一个地点。
强制 - 在盲目舞者通过其猎手关键词移动到一个虚空格子后：再次结算其猎手关键词。(每轮仅限一次。)
cards.textEn:
Spawn - Farthest empty space.
Hunter.
Mindless Dancer can enter empty space as if it were a location.
Forced - After Mindless Dancer moves to an empty space via its hunter keyword: Resolve its hunter keyword again. (Limit once per round.)

cards.name: Ultimate Chaos
cards.text:
显现 - 检定[willpower](4)。如果你检定失败，将究极混沌附属到阿撒托斯上。如果你检定失败且低于难度至少2点，受到1点伤害和1点恐惧。如果你检定失败且低于难度至少3点，究极混沌获得涌动。不能被取消。
如果阿撒托斯上附属了3张究极混沌，将其全部弃掉，并在阿撒托斯上放置1个毁灭标记或阿撒托斯按玩家顺序攻击每位调查员。不能被取消。
cards.textEn:
Revelation - Test [willpower] (4). If you fail, attach Ultimate Chaos to Azathoth. If you fail by 2 or more, take 1 damage and 1 horror. If you fail by 3 or more, Ultimate Chaos gains surge. Cannot be canceled.
If there are 3 copies of Ultimate Chaos attached to Azathoth, discard them and either place 1 doom on Azathoth, or Azathoth attacks each investigator in player order. Cannot be canceled.

cards.name: Whispered Bargain
cards.text:
险境。
显现 - 你必须(选择一项)：在阿撒托斯上放置1个毁灭标记，或阿撒托斯攻击你。
cards.textEn:
Peril.
Revelation - You must either (choose one): Place 1 doom on Azathoth, or Azathoth attacks you.

cards.name: The End is Nigh!
cards.text: 显现 - 检定[willpower](1)。本次检定难度+X，其中X为当前密谋编号。如果场上没有密谋，X为4。如果你检定失败，将场上每个[[异教徒]]敌人上的每个毁灭标记移动到阿撒托斯上(如果场上没有[[异教徒]]敌人，则在阿撒托斯上放置1个毁灭标记)。
cards.textEn: Revelation - Test [willpower] (1). This test gets +X difficulty, where X is the current agenda number. If there is no agenda in play, X is 4. If you fail, move each doom on each [[Cultist]] enemy in play to Azathoth (or place 1 doom on Azathoth if there are no [[Cultist]] enemies in play).

cards.name: A World in Darkness
cards.text:
显现 - 如果阿撒托斯上没有毁灭标记，黑暗世界获得涌动。否则，阿撒托斯上每有1个毁灭标记，你必须选择以下一项：
- 失去1资源。
- 选择并弃掉你1张手牌。
- 受到1点恐惧。
- 受到1点伤害。
cards.textEn:
Revelation - If there is no doom on Azathoth, A World in Darkness gains surge. Otherwise, for each doom on Azathoth, you must choose one:
- Lose 1 resource.
- Choose and discard 1 card from your hand.
- Take 1 horror.
- Take 1 damage.

cards.name: Azathoth
cards.text:
阿撒托斯懵懂不察而又无所不能。其免疫所有玩家的卡牌效果和调查员行动，并且不能被任何方式击败。
强制 - 如果阿撒托斯上有至少10个毁灭标记：盲目愚痴之神从它究级混沌虚空的王座升起，吞食宇宙。(→结局1)
cards.textEn:
Azathoth is oblivious and omnipotent. It is immune to all player card effects and investigator actions, and cannot be defeated by any means.
Forced - If there is 10 or more doom on Azathoth: The Blind Idiot God rises from its throne in the ultimate void of chaos and devours the universe. (→R1)

cards.name: Piper of Azathoth
cards.text:
猎物 - 剩余神智值最低。
警戒。猎手。反击。
强制 - 在敌军阶段结束时：阿撒托斯的吹笛手攻击其所在地点未与其交战的每位调查员(不论其是处于重整状态还是横置状态)。
cards.textEn:
Prey - Least remaining sanity.
Alert. Hunter. Retaliate.
Forced - When the enemy phase ends: Piper of Azathoth attacks each investigator it is not engaged with at its location (regardless of whether it is ready or exhausted).

cards.name: Daemonic Piping
cards.text:
涌动。
显现 - 如果阿撒托斯的吹笛手在场，对其所在地点和每个连接地点的每位调查员造成1点恐惧。否则，将魔鬼的笛声放置入场，放在密谋牌库旁边。
如果场上有3张魔鬼的笛声，弃掉这3张卡牌，阿撒托斯的吹笛手生成与其猎物交战(从场外的任意区域生成)。
cards.textEn:
Surge.
Revelation - If Piper of Azathoth is in play, deal 1 horror to each investigator at its location and at each connecting location. Otherwise, put Daemonic Piping into play next to the agenda deck.
If there are 3 copies of Daemonic Piping in play, discard them and spawn the Piper of Azathoth engaged with its prey (from any out of play area).

cards.name: Coven Initiate
cards.text: 显现 - 弃掉遭遇牌库顶2张卡牌。如果本效果导致遭遇牌库的卡牌耗尽，抽取遭遇弃牌堆最顶部的[[巫术]]卡牌。
cards.textEn: Revelation - Discard the top 2 cards of the encounter deck. If this effect causes the encounter deck to run out of cards, draw the topmost [[Hex]] card in the encounter discard pile.

cards.name: Priestess of the Coven
cards.text:
反击。
遭遇弃牌堆每有1个[[女巫]]敌人，女巫集会的女祭司得到+1攻击和+1躲避(最多+3攻击和+3躲避)。
强制 - 在遭遇牌库的卡牌耗尽时：女巫集会的女祭司重整并攻击其所在地点的每位调查员。
cards.textEn:
Retaliate.
Priestess of the Coven gets +1 fight and +1 evade for each [[Witch]] enemy in the encounter discard pile (to a maximum of +3 fight and +3 evade).
Forced - When the encounter deck runs out of cards: Priestess of the Coven readies and attacks each investigator at its location.

cards.name: At Death's Doorstep
cards.text:
简单/普通
[skull]：-1(如果你所在地点闹鬼，改为-3)。
[tablet]：-2。如果你检定失败且本次检定为攻击或躲避尝试，结算你所在地点的每个闹鬼能力。
[elder_thing]：-2。如果你所在地点有[[幽灵]]敌人，受到1点伤害。
cards.textEn:
Easy / Standard
[skull]: -1 (-3 instead if your location is haunted).
[tablet]: -2. If you fail and this is an attack or evasion attempt, resolve each haunted ability on your location.
[elder_thing]: -2. If there is a [[Spectral]] enemy at your location, take 1 damage.

cards.name: JUSTICE • XI
cards.backText:
调查员团队如果未拥有3[per_investigator]个线索，则失去其所有线索。
调查员团队如果有至少3[per_investigator]个线索，则其必须花费3[per_investigator]个线索，并将放在一边的约瑟夫·梅吉尔敌人生成在除入口大厅以外离所有调查员最远的地点。
打开剧本日志，进入幕间故事I：失踪人口记录。
此幕间故事结束后，移除场上每个地点的所有线索，推进到场景1b。
cards.text:
[[银暮秘社]]敌人不能被伤害也不能被击败。
强制 - 在你抽取[[怪物]]敌人时：该敌人不生成，改为放在一边，位于场外，并在本密谋上放置1个毁灭标记。本效果能导致本密谋推进。
cards.textEn:
[[Silver Twilight]] enemies cannot be damaged or defeated.
Forced - When you draw a [[Monster]] enemy: Instead of spawning it, set it aside, out of play, and place 1 doom on this agenda. This effect can cause this agenda to advance.

cards.name: Over the Threshold
cards.backText:
- 调查员如果在场景2，其被囚禁在幽灵国度。(→结局3)
- 调查员如果在场景3，其勉强捡回了小命。每位没有撒退的调查员被击败并承承受1点肉体创伤。
cards.text:
每个[[银暮秘社]]敌人获得胜利0，且在敌军阶段如要决定猎手敌人的移动方向，将其视为调查员。
强制 - 在敌军阶段的“猎手敌人移动”步骤后：所有重整状态的[[幽灵]]敌人对同一地点的每个[[类人]]敌人造成等于自己伤害值的伤害。
cards.textEn:
Each [[Silver Twilight]] enemy gains Victory 0, and counts as an investigator for the purpose of determining where hunter enemies move during the enemy phase.
Forced - After the 'hunter enemies move' step of the enemy phase: Each ready [[Spectral]] enemy deals its damage value to each [[Humanoid]] enemy at its location.

cards.name: Hidden Agendas
cards.backText:
将位于入口大厅的每位调查员和每个敌人移动到维多利亚式宴会厅。
对于场上每个地点，从放在一边的卡牌中找出一张该地点的[[幽灵]]版本并替换(原地点上的所有标记和卡牌视为位于新版本地点)。如果该地点上有调查员，将其揭示。
按玩家顺序，每位调查员将1个放在一边的[[怪物]]敌人生成在自己地点，直到所有放在一边的[[怪物]]敌人都已生成。
将放在一边的幽灵看守人敌人生成在入口大厅。将放在一边的看守人遭遇组的剩余卡牌、和放在一边冥界遭遇组的剩余卡牌连同遭遇弃牌堆一起洗入遭遇牌库。
cards.text: 目标 - 通过发现尽可能多的线索，找到有关失踪事件的信息。(不要推进场景，直到你受到指示。) (提示：失踪人口最后所在的地点或许值得一查。)
cards.textEn: Objective - Find information about the disappearances by discovering as many clues as you can. (Do not advance until you are instructed.) (Hint: it may be worthwhile to investigate the last known locations of the missing persons.)

cards.name: The Spectral Realm
cards.backText:
阻挡你逃离的迷雾渐渐散去。揭示入口大厅。
将遭遇弃牌堆洗入遭遇牌库。

cards.name: Escape the Cage
cards.text:
强制 - 当一轮结束时：位于入口大厅的所有[[银暮秘社]]敌人逃走；将其放在入口大厅底下，位于场外。将所有处于重整状态且带有冷漠关键词的[[银暮秘社]]敌人向入口大厅移动一次。
目标 - 如果所有未被击败的调查员都撤退，推进场景。
cards.textEn:
Forced - At the end of the round: Each [[Silver Twilight]] enemy in the Entry Hall escapes; place them beneath the Entry Hall, out of play. Move each ready [[Silver Twilight]] enemy with the aloof keyword once toward the Entry Hall.
Objective - If each undefeated investigator has resigned, advance.

cards.name: Office
cards.backText: 位于办公室的所有[[银暮秘社]]敌人失去冷漠关键词。

cards.name: Entry Hall
cards.backText: 鬼灵迷雾形成的壁障封锁了入口大厅。你不能进入入口大厅。[[银暮秘社]]敌人不能生成在入口大厅。

cards.name: Josef Meiger
cards.text:
反击。
[action]如果其他[[银暮秘社]]敌人上没有毁灭标记：谈判。检定[intellect](4)来让约瑟夫相信这不是你干的。如果你检定失败，约瑟夫·梅吉尔攻击你。如果你检定成功，将本卡牌翻面并结算其文本。
cards.textEn:
Retaliate.
[action] If no other [[Silver Twilight]] enemy has doom on it: Parley. Test [intellect] (4) to convince Josef that this is not your doing. If you fail, Josef Meiger attacks you. If you succeed, flip this card over and resolve its text.

cards.name: Josef's Plan
cards.text:
移除本卡牌上的所有毁灭标记。
在本局游戏的剩余时间里，毁灭标记不能被放在[[银暮秘社]]敌人上，约瑟夫·梅吉尔获得冷漠。
将本卡牌翻回敌人面，并与所有调查员解除交战状态。
cards.textEn:
Remove all doom from this card.
For the remainder of the game, doom cannot be placed on [[Silver Twilight]] enemies, and Josef Meiger gains aloof.
Flip this card back to its enemy side and disengage it from all investigators.

cards.name: Before the Black Throne
cards.text:
简单/普通
[skull]：-X。X为阿撒托斯上毁灭标记数量的一半(向上取整)，至少为2。
[cultist]：再揭示1个标记。如果你检定失败，查找遭遇牌库和遭遇弃牌堆，找出一张[[异教徒]]敌人，并将其抽取。混洗遭遇牌库。
[tablet]：-2。如果你检定失败，阿撒托斯攻击你。
[elder_thing]：-4。如果你本次检定经过修正后的技能值为0，在阿撒托斯上放置1个毁灭标记。
cards.textEn:
Easy / Standard
[skull]: -X. X is half of the doom on Azathoth (rounded up), to a minimum of 2.
[cultist]: Reveal another token. If you fail, search the encounter deck and discard pile for a [[Cultist]] enemy and draw it. Shuffle the encounter deck.
[tablet]: -2. If you fail, Azathoth attacks you.
[elder_thing]: -4. If your modified skill value for this test is 0, place 1 doom on Azathoth.

cards.name: WHEEL OF FORTUNE · X
cards.backText:
每个[[异教徒]]敌人为仪式而自决。弃掉场上每个[[异教徒]]敌人，并将他们的所有毁灭标记移动到阿撒托斯。
调查员队长必须查找遭遇牌库和遭遇弃牌堆，找出一张魔鬼的笛声并将其抽取。
通往你目的地的一路上全是无尽的步道和黑色石阶。这是一个无法走出的迷宫。
检查剧本日志。如果“遗留记忆”下方列有吉尔曼的日记，你可以找到出路。否则，你绝望地迷路了；每位调查员必须移动到其左方的地点，或将其地点向左移动一次(在其原来的位置放置一个虚空格子)。地点不能通过本效果移动超过一次。
cards.text:
每个地点与其相邻的每个地点相互连接。
在本密谋推进时，不要移除敌人的毁灭标记。
cards.textEn:
Each location is connected to each location adjacent to it.
Do not remove doom from enemies when this agenda advances.

cards.name: It Awaits
cards.backText:
每个[[异教徒]]敌人为仪式而自决。弃掉场上每个[[异教徒]]敌人，并将他们的所有毁灭标记移动到阿撒托斯。
调查员队长必须查找遭遇牌库和遭遇弃牌堆，找出一张魔鬼的笛声并将其抽取。
在这超越时间之外的遗忘之地，一切都不复原样。云雾在你周围飞舞翻腾。远处传来的笑声嘲笑着你，黑色星云里出现了一道熟悉的鬼魂——一个早已死去的人。
检查剧本日志。如果“遗留记忆”下方列有磨损的十字架，鬼魂认得你从沃尔特·吉尔曼房间偷来的十字架，缓缓后退，遁入彼端的黑暗之中。
否则，鬼魂攻击你；每位调查员必须检定[willpower](4)。每位检定失败的调查员受到1点伤害和1点恐惧。
cards.text:
每个地点与其相邻的每个地点相互连接。
在本密谋推进时，不要移除敌人的毁灭标记。
cards.textEn:
Each location is connected to each location adjacent to it.
Do not remove doom from enemies when this agenda advances.

cards.name: The Final Countdown
cards.backText:
每个[[异教徒]]敌人为仪式而自决。弃掉场上每个[[异教徒]]敌人，并将他们的所有毁灭标记移动到阿撒托斯。
调查员队长必须查找遭遇牌库和遭遇弃牌堆，找出一张魔鬼的笛声并将其抽取。
密谋牌库不复存在，但本场冒险没有结束。直到本场冒险结束，将要放到当前密谋上的毁灭标记，改为放到阿撒托斯上，且场上所有毁灭标记视为在阿撒托斯上。
你遇到另一伙阿撒托斯的崇拜者，一个无形的兜帽者带领着他们，将一盏古老的提灯高举过头。提灯黯淡的灰色光芒根本无法照亮这个国度的黑暗。不知为何，你觉得那幽灵很是熟悉；某种说不清的亲切感驱使着你前进。
检查剧本日志。如果“遗留记忆”下方列有玉米皮娃娃，那幽灵也认出了你。它好奇地盯着你看，周围一圈信徒停止了祈祷；移除阿撒托斯的1个毁灭标记。否则，那幽灵几乎没有注意到你，周围一圈祈祷者继续咏唱。
cards.text:
每个地点与其相邻的每个地点相互连接。
在本密谋推进时，不要移除敌人的毁灭标记。 (注意——在本密谋推进时，本场冒险不会结束，但世界末日即将到来。)
cards.textEn:
Each location is connected to each location adjacent to it.
Do not remove doom from enemies when this agenda advances. (Beware - the scenario will not end when this agenda advances, but the doom of the world will be close at hand.)

cards.name: The Cosmos Beckons
cards.backText:
将宇宙入口从游戏中移除。将每个虚空格子的卡牌洗入其所有者牌库，将场上除憎恶宫殿以外的所有地点洗入“宇宙”。(FAQ，v1.7)位于这些地点的所有调查员被抛弃并阵亡。将这些地点的每个敌人与遭遇牌库顶的5张卡牌一同混洗，放到遭遇牌库顶。
拿取放在一边的旧日支配者皇廷和“宇宙”顶上的2张卡牌，将其混洗至无法分辨。然后，将这3张卡牌与虚空格子一同放置入场，如剧本手册中“场景2的地点摆放位置”所示。
按玩家顺序，每位调查员抽取遭遇牌库顶1张卡牌。
cards.text:
[action]花费X个线索：抽取“宇宙”顶上的X张卡牌。选择其中一张卡牌，按照其“宇宙 -”指示放置入场，并移动到其上。将其余卡牌洗回“宇宙”。
目标 - 只有憎恶宫殿的调查员可以共同花费所需数量的线索以推进场景。(注意——不位于该处的所有调查员将会阵亡。)
cards.textEn:
[action] Spend X clues: Draw the top X cards of the Cosmos. Choose one to put into play using its "Cosmos -" instructions, and move to it. Shuffle the rest back into the Cosmos.
Objective - Only investigators at Hideous Palace may spend the requisite number of clues, as a group, to advance. (Beware - any investigator who is not there will be killed.)

cards.name: In Azathoth's Domain
cards.backText:
将憎恶宫殿从游戏中移除。将每个虚空格子的卡牌洗入其所有者牌库，将场上除旧日支配者皇廷以外的所有地点洗入“宇宙”。(FAQ，v1.7)位于这些地点的所有调查员被抛弃并阵亡。将这些地点的每个敌人与遭遇牌库顶的5张卡牌一同混洗，放到遭遇牌库顶。
拿取放在一边的黑色王座和“宇宙”顶上的3张卡牌，将其混洗至无法分辨。然后，将这4张卡牌与虚空格子一同放置入场，如剧本手册中“场景3的地点摆放位置”所示。
按玩家顺序，每位调查员抽取遭遇牌库顶1张卡牌。
cards.text:
[action]花费X个线索：抽取“宇宙”顶上的X张卡牌。选择其中一张卡牌，按照其“宇宙 -”指示放置入场，并移动到其上。将其余卡牌洗回“宇宙”。
目标 - 只有旧日支配者皇廷的调查员可以共同花费所需数量的线索以推进场景。(注意——不位于该处的所有调查员将会阵亡。)
cards.textEn:
[action] Spend X clues: Draw the top X cards of the Cosmos. Choose one to put into play using its "Cosmos -" instructions, and move to it. Shuffle the rest back into the Cosmos.
Objective - Only investigators at Court of the Great Old Ones may spend the requisite number of clues, as a group, to advance. (Beware - any investigator who is not there will be killed.)

cards.name: What Must Be Done
cards.backText:
检查剧本日志。
- 如果达成下方至少2种情况，你可以前往(→结局2)：你接受了自己的命运、“遗留记忆”下方列有催眠长笛、“遗留记忆”下方列有仪式道具。
- 如果达成下方至少2种情况，你可以前往(→结局3)：你拒绝了自己的命运、“遗留记忆”下方列有残影碎片、“遗留记忆”下方列有一缕鬼灵迷雾。
- 否则，(→结局4)。
cards.text:
[action]花费X个线索：抽取“宇宙”顶上的X张卡牌。选择其中一张卡牌，按照其“宇宙 -”指示放置入场，并移动到其上。将其余卡牌洗回“宇宙”。
目标 - 如果调查员队长位于黑色王座，且该地点上没有线索，推进场景。
cards.textEn:
[action] Spend X clues: Draw the top X cards of the Cosmos. Choose one to put into play using its "Cosmos -" instructions, and move to it. Shuffle the rest back into the Cosmos.
Objective - If the lead investigator is at The Black Throne and there are no clues on it, advance.

cards.name: Court of the Great Old Ones
Mindless Dancer
cards.text:
生成 - 最远的虚空格子。
猎手。
盲目舞者可以进入虚空格子，如同其进入一个地点。
强制 - 在盲目舞者通过其猎手关键词移动到一个虚空格子后：再次结算其猎手关键词。(每轮仅限一次。)
cards.textEn:
Spawn - Farthest empty space.
Hunter.
Mindless Dancer can enter empty space as if it were a location.
Forced - After Mindless Dancer moves to an empty space via its hunter keyword: Resolve its hunter keyword again. (Limit once per round.)

cards.name: Ultimate Chaos
cards.text:
显现 - 检定[willpower](4)。如果你检定失败，将究极混沌附属到阿撒托斯上。如果你检定失败且低于难度至少2点，受到1点伤害和1点恐惧。如果你检定失败且低于难度至少3点，究极混沌获得涌动。不能被取消。
如果阿撒托斯上附属了3张究极混沌，将其全部弃掉，并在阿撒托斯上放置1个毁灭标记或阿撒托斯按玩家顺序攻击每位调查员。不能被取消。
cards.textEn:
Revelation - Test [willpower] (4). If you fail, attach Ultimate Chaos to Azathoth. If you fail by 2 or more, take 1 damage and 1 horror. If you fail by 3 or more, Ultimate Chaos gains surge. Cannot be canceled.
If there are 3 copies of Ultimate Chaos attached to Azathoth, discard them and either place 1 doom on Azathoth, or Azathoth attacks each investigator in player order. Cannot be canceled.

cards.name: Whispered Bargain
cards.text:
险境。
显现 - 你必须(选择一项)：在阿撒托斯上放置1个毁灭标记，或阿撒托斯攻击你。
cards.textEn:
Peril.
Revelation - You must either (choose one): Place 1 doom on Azathoth, or Azathoth attacks you.

cards.name: The End is Nigh!
cards.text: 显现 - 检定[willpower](1)。本次检定难度+X，其中X为当前密谋编号。如果场上没有密谋，X为4。如果你检定失败，将场上每个[[异教徒]]敌人上的每个毁灭标记移动到阿撒托斯上(如果场上没有[[异教徒]]敌人，则在阿撒托斯上放置1个毁灭标记)。
cards.textEn: Revelation - Test [willpower] (1). This test gets +X difficulty, where X is the current agenda number. If there is no agenda in play, X is 4. If you fail, move each doom on each [[Cultist]] enemy in play to Azathoth (or place 1 doom on Azathoth if there are no [[Cultist]] enemies in play).

cards.name: A World in Darkness
cards.text:
显现 - 如果阿撒托斯上没有毁灭标记，黑暗世界获得涌动。否则，阿撒托斯上每有1个毁灭标记，你必须选择以下一项：
- 失去1资源。
- 选择并弃掉你1张手牌。
- 受到1点恐惧。
- 受到1点伤害。
cards.textEn:
Revelation - If there is no doom on Azathoth, A World in Darkness gains surge. Otherwise, for each doom on Azathoth, you must choose one:
- Lose 1 resource.
- Choose and discard 1 card from your hand.
- Take 1 horror.
- Take 1 damage.

cards.name: Azathoth
cards.text:
阿撒托斯懵懂不察而又无所不能。其免疫所有玩家的卡牌效果和调查员行动，并且不能被任何方式击败。
强制 - 如果阿撒托斯上有至少10个毁灭标记：盲目愚痴之神从它究级混沌虚空的王座升起，吞食宇宙。(→结局1)
cards.textEn:
Azathoth is oblivious and omnipotent. It is immune to all player card effects and investigator actions, and cannot be defeated by any means.
Forced - If there is 10 or more doom on Azathoth: The Blind Idiot God rises from its throne in the ultimate void of chaos and devours the universe. (→R1)

cards.name: Evil Past
cards.text:
显现 -  如果你的威胁区域里没有邪恶往昔，将邪恶往昔放置入场，位于你的威胁区域(如果已有邪恶往昔，改为将本卡牌弃掉并获得涌动)。
强制 - 在遭遇牌库的卡牌耗尽时：受到2点恐惧并检定[willpower](3)。如果你检定成功，弃掉邪恶往昔。
cards.textEn:
Revelation - Put Evil Past into play in your threat area if there is no copy of it in your threat area (if there is, discard Evil Past and it gains surge instead).
Forced - When the encounter deck runs out of cards: Take 2 horror and test [willpower] (3). If you succeed, discard Evil Past.

cards.name: Centuries of Secrets
cards.text: 显现 - 检定[willpower](5)。你检定失败且每低于难度1点，弃掉遭遇牌库顶1张卡牌。如果本效果弃掉了[[诅咒]]诡计，对你的调查员和你的每个[[盟友]]支援造成1点直接伤害。
cards.textEn: Revelation - Test [willpower] (5). For each point you fail by, discard the top card of the encounter deck. If a [[Curse]] treachery is discarded by this effect, deal 1 direct damage to your investigator and to each of your [[Ally]] assets.

cards.name: Disappearance at the Twilight Estate
cards.text:
简单/普通
[skull]：-3。如果你检定失败且本次检定为攻击或躲避尝试，结算你所在地点的每个闹鬼能力。
cards.textEn:
Easy / Standard
[skull]: -3. If you fail and this is an attack or evasion attempt, resolve each haunted ability on your location.

cards.name: JUDGEMENT • XX
cards.backText:
按照以下指示，在剧本日志的“失踪人口”部分，你角色旁记录该角色的命运。然后，将本密谋翻回另一面。
- 如果你因幽灵看守人的攻击而被击败，记录下(角色姓名)被看守人抓走。
- 如果你因[[怪物]]敌人的攻击而被击败，记录下(角色姓名)已被幽灵夺走性命。
- 如果在本密谋推进时，场上至少有7个毁灭标记，且你因密谋1a的强制能力造成的恐惧或伤害被击败，记录下(角色姓名)消失在迷雾之中。
- 如果你因其他任何效果而被击败，记录下(角色姓名)被拉入幽灵国度。
cards.text:
强制 - 在任何卡牌上放置了毁灭标记后：每位调查员必须受到1点伤害或1点恐惧(如果场上有至少5个毁灭标记，改为受到2点伤害或2点恐惧)。
强制 - 在任何调查员被击败时，该调查员必须推进此密谋。在本密谋推进时，不要移除其上任何毁灭标记。
cards.textEn:
Forced - After doom is placed on any card: Each investigator must either take 1 damage or 1 horror (2 damage or 2 horror instead if there is 5 or more doom in play).
Forced - When any investigator is defeated, that investigator must advance this agenda. Do not remove any doom from this agenda when it advances.

cards.name: The Disappearance
cards.backText:
在剧本日志中，记录下你被追捕。
翻回场景1a。
cards.text:
强制 - 在有调查员退场时：改为将该调查员的每个线索放在本场景上，而不是放在所在地点。
目标 - 在你不可避免的末日来临之前，发现尽可能多的线索。
cards.textEn:
Forced - When an investigator is eliminated: Place each of that investigator's clues on this act instead of his or her location.
Objective - Discover as many clues as you can before your inevitable demise.

cards.name: For the Greater Good
cards.text:
简单/普通
[skull]：-X。其中X为场上毁灭标记最多的[[异教徒]]敌人上的毁灭标记数量。
[cultist]：-2。再揭示一个标记。
[tablet]：-3。如果你检定失败，在最近的[[异教徒]]敌人上放置1个毁灭标记。
[elder_thing]：-3。如果你检定失败，将最近的[[异教徒]]敌人上的1个毁灭标记移动到当前密谋。
cards.textEn:
Easy / Standard
[skull]: -X. X is the highest number of doom on a [[Cultist]] enemy in play.
[cultist]: -2. Reveal another token.
[tablet]: -3. If you fail, place 1 doom on the nearest [[Cultist]] enemy.
[elder_thing]: -3. If you fail, move 1 doom from the nearest [[Cultist]] enemy to the current agenda.

cards.name: THE HIEROPHANT · V
cards.backText: 弃掉遭遇牌库顶5张卡牌。按玩家顺序，每位调查员必须抽取1张以此方式弃掉的[[异教徒]]敌人。
cards.text: 强制 - 在你击败一个[[银暮秘社]]敌人时：你匆忙之中遗漏了一些证据。将位于该地点的每个敌人的1个毁灭标记移动到当前密谋。
cards.textEn: Forced - When you defeat a [[Silver Twilight]] enemy: You leave behind some evidence of the scuffle. Move 1 doom from each enemy at that location to the current agenda.

cards.name: Ends and Means
cards.backText: 显现 - 以崇高的利益替代场景和密谋牌库。将放在一边的响应召唤的怪兽生成在机关盒所在地点(如果机关盒不在场，则生成在任意一个[[圣堂]]地点)，并将机关盒从游戏中移除。
cards.text:
位于[[圣堂]]地点的每个[[银暮秘社]]敌人失去冷漠。
强制 - 在你击败一个[[银暮秘社]]敌人时：你匆忙之中遗漏了一些证据。将位于该地点的每个敌人的1个毁灭标记移动到当前密谋。
cards.textEn:
Each [[Silver Twilight]] enemy in a [[Sanctum]] location loses aloof.
Forced - When you defeat a [[Silver Twilight]] enemy: You leave behind some evidence of the scuffle. Move 1 doom from each enemy at that location to the current agenda.

cards.name: Warm Welcome
cards.backText:
如果藏书室不在场上，将其放置入场。
将放在一边的南森·威克敌人生成在藏书室，(引导大师)面朝上。将放在一边的机关盒剧情支援附属到他身上。

cards.name: Infiltrating the Lodge
cards.backText:
如果圣堂内室不在场上，将其放置入场。
将放在一边的南森·威克敌人生成在圣堂内室，(教化大师)面朝上放置。将放在一边的机关盒剧情支援附属到他身上。
直到游戏结束，当前场景获得：“[reaction]在你躲避一个敌人后：移除其所有毁灭标记。”将本卡牌放到场景牌库旁作为提醒，然后推进至场景2a。
cards.text: [reaction]在你躲避一个敌人后：移除其所有的毁灭标记。
cards.textEn: [reaction] After you evade an enemy: Remove all doom from it.

cards.name: Obtaining the Device
cards.backText:
如果你通过击败南森·威克推进场景：
你迅速从南森的手中撬走仪器，趁着无人发觉，逃离现场。如果你通过躲避南森·威克推进场景：
你趁着南森不注意，从他身旁的桌上偷走了仪器。当他意识到仪器不见了的时候，你早已离开。如果你通过与南森·威克谈判推进场景：
“好吧，听着。”南森安静地说道，“事实是，可能有另一种更安全的方法能打开仪器。这座建筑有着许多秘密；远比你能知道的要多。但是时间不多了，桑福德先生希望能在午夜之前把它打开。如果你能够在那之前打开，当然再好不过。不然的话，那……要是我是你，等到我们要强行打开它的时候，我可不会待在它边上。”他将仪器递给你，然后静静地离开。
cards.text: 目标 - 如果南森·威克以任何方式加入到胜利牌区，选择一位调查员来控制附属的机关盒，并推进场景。
cards.textEn: Objective - If Nathan Wick is added to the victory display by any means, choose an investigator to take control of the attached Puzzle Box, and advance.

cards.name: The Four Keys
cards.backText:
检查剧本日志。
- 如果调查员成为了秘社一员， (→结局1)。
- 否则，(→结局2)。
cards.text: 目标 - 如果同在一个地点的调查员控制了机关盒、[skull]钥匙、[cultist]钥匙、[tablet]和[elder_thing]钥匙，推进场景。
cards.textEn: Objective - If investigators at the same location control the Puzzle Box, the [skull] key, the [cultist] key, the [tablet] key, and the [elder_thing] key, advance.

cards.name: Lobby
cards.backText:
银暮秘社的入口有人把守。你不能进入前厅。
秘社大门获得：“[action]：谈判。看门人在梅吉尔庄园见过你，于是让你进门。揭示前厅。”

cards.name: Lodge Cellar
cards.backText:
银暮秘社的后门是隐藏起来的。你不能进入秘社地窖。
秘社大门获得：“[action]位于秘社大门的调查员共同花费1[per_investigator]个线索：揭示秘社地窖。”

cards.name: Vault
cards.backText: 机密室的门锁上了。你不能进入机密室，除非你控制[elder_thing]钥匙。

cards.name: Lodge Catacombs
cards.backText: 地下墓穴的门锁上了。你不能进入秘社地下墓穴，除非你控制至少1个([skull]/[cultist]/[tablet]/[elder_thing])钥匙。

cards.name: Inner Sanctum
cards.backText: 圣堂内室的门锁上了。你不能进入圣堂内室，除非你控制[cultist]钥匙。

cards.name: Nathan Wick
cards.text:
反击。
[action]：谈判。检定[willpower](3)以说服南森再给你一次机会。如果你检定成功，在南森·威克上放置1资源。然后，如果其上有1[per_investigator]个资源，将其加入胜利牌区。如果你检定失败，南森·威克攻击你。
cards.textEn:
Retaliate.
[action]: Parley. Test [willpower] (3) to persuade Nathan to let you find another option. If you succeed, place 1 resource on Nathan Wick. Then, if there are 1 [per_investigator] resources on him, add him to the victory display. If you fail, Nathan Wick attacks you.

cards.name: Nathan Wick
cards.text:
警戒。
强制 - 你躲避南森·威克成功并超过难度3点或更多后：你偷了机关盒。将南森·威克加入胜利牌区。
cards.textEn:
Alert.
Forced - After you evade Nathan Wick by 3 or more: You steal the puzzle box. Add Nathan Wick to the victory display.

cards.name: Lodge Jailor
cards.text:
生成 - 任意一个[[圣堂]]地点。
冷漠。
强制 - 在秘社狱卒入场后：在其上放置2个毁灭标记和随机1个放在一边的钥匙。
[action]：谈判。检定[intellect](3)。如果你检定成功，移除秘社狱卒上的1个毁灭标记或控制其钥匙。
cards.textEn:
Spawn - Any [[Sanctum]] location.
Aloof.
Forced - After Lodge Jailor enters play: Place 2 doom and 1 random set-aside key on it.
[action]: Parley. Test [intellect] (3). If you succeed, either remove 1 doom from Lodge Jailor, or take control of its key.

cards.name: Cell Keeper
cards.text:
生成 - 任意一个[[圣堂]]地点。
警戒。
强制 - 在牢房看门人入场后：在其上放置2个毁灭标记和随机1个放在一边的钥匙。
强制 - 在你躲避牢房看门人成功并超过难度2点或更多时：控制其钥匙。
cards.textEn:
Spawn - Any [[Sanctum]] location.
Alert.
Forced - After Cell Keeper enters play: Place 2 doom and 1 random set-aside key on it.
Forced - When you evade Cell Keeper by 2 or more: Take control of its key.

cards.name: Summoned Beast
cards.text:
反击。猎手。
场上每有2个毁灭标记，响应召唤的怪兽得到+1攻击，+1躲避，+1伤害和+ 1恐惧。
强制 - 当敌军阶段开始时：响应召唤的怪兽击败其所在地点的每个[[类人]]敌人。将这些敌人上的所有毁灭标记移动到响应召唤的怪兽身上。
目标 - 如果本敌人被击败，(→结局3)。
cards.textEn:
Retaliate. Hunter.
Summoned Beast gets +1 fight, +1 evade, +1 damage, and +1 horror for every 2 doom in play.
Forced - At the start of the enemy phase: Summoned Beast defeats each [[Humanoid]] enemy at its location. Move all doom from each of those enemies to Summoned Beast.
Objective - If the Summoned Beast is defeated, (→R3).

cards.name: Knight of the Inner Circle
cards.text:
生成 - 任意一个与你所在地点连接的地点。
猎物 - 控制最多([skull]/[cultist]/[tablet]/[elder_thing])钥匙。
警戒。冷漠。猎手。
强制 - 在你进入核心圈骑士所在地点(或核心圈骑士进入你所在地点)后：检定[agility](4)。如果你检定失败，核心圈骑士与你交战。
cards.textEn:
Spawn - Any location connected to yours.
Prey - Most ([skull]/[cultist]/[tablet]/[elder_thing]) keys controlled.
Alert. Aloof. Hunter.
Forced - After you enter Knight of the Inner Circle's location (or vice-versa): Test [agility] (4). If you fail, Knight of the Inner Circle engages you.

cards.name: Knight of the Outer Void
cards.text:
生成 - 任意一个与你所在地点连接的地点。
冷漠。险境。反击。
显现 - 在边缘虚空骑士生成后，在其上放置1个或2个毁灭标记。
[action]：谈判。检定[willpower]或[intellect](4)。如果你检定成功，控制边缘虚空骑士上的1个毁灭标记并将其翻至线索面。如果你检定失败，边缘虚空骑士攻击你。
cards.textEn:
Spawn - Any location connected to yours.
Aloof. Peril. Retaliate.
Revelation - After Knight of the Outer Void spawns, place either 1 or 2 doom on it.
[action]: Parley. Test [willpower] or [intellect] (4). If you succeed, take control of 1 doom on Knight of the Outer Void, and flip it to its clue side. If you fail, Knight of the Outer Void attacks you.

cards.name: Call to Order
cards.text: 显现 - 找到遭遇弃牌堆中最顶部的2张[[异教徒]]敌人，将他们生成在剩余线索最多的无人地点。如果没有因本效果生成[[异教徒]]敌人，发号施令获得涌动。
cards.textEn: Revelation - Find the 2 topmost [[Cultist]] enemies in the encounter discard pile and spawn them in the empty location with the most remaining clues. If no [[Cultist]] enemies are spawned by this effect, Call to Order gains surge.

cards.name: Expulsion
cards.text: 显现 - 如果场上没有[[异教徒]]敌人，除籍获得涌动。否则，最近的[[异教徒]]敌人重整并移动(每次移动1个地点)直到它到达你所在地点，与你交战，并立即进行一次攻击。然后，将你控制的每个([skull]/[cultist]/[tablet]/[elder_thing])钥匙放到该敌人身上。
cards.textEn: Revelation - If there are no [[Cultist]] enemies in play, Expulsion gains surge. Otherwise, the nearest [[Cultist]] enemy readies, moves (one location at a time) until it reaches your location, engages you, and makes an immediate attack. Then, place each ([skull]/[cultist]/[tablet]/[elder_thing]) key you control on that enemy.

cards.name: Beneath the Lodge
cards.text:
如果你控制至少1个([skull]/[cultist]/[tablet]/[elder_thing])钥匙，秘社地底获得险境且其技能检定得到难度+1。
显现 - 检定[intellect](3)。你失败且每低于难度1点，你必须失去1个线索或受到1点恐惧。
cards.textEn:
If you control at least 1 ([skull]/[cultist]/[tablet]/[elder_thing]) key, Beneath the Lodge gains peril and its skill test gets +1 difficulty.
Revelation - Test [intellect] (3). For each point you fail by, you must either lose 1 clue or take 1 horror.

cards.name: Mark of the Order
cards.text:
涌动。
显现 - 检查控制每个钥匙的调查员。如果调查员带有……
- ……[skull]钥匙，受到1点伤害。
- ……[cultist]钥匙，受到1点恐惧。
- ……[tablet]钥匙，随机弃掉2张手牌。
- ……[elder_thing]钥匙，失去3资源。
cards.textEn:
Surge.
Revelation - Check which investigator controls each key. The investigator with...
- ...the [skull] key takes 1 damage.
- ...the [cultist] key takes 1 horror.
- ...the [tablet] key discards 2 random cards from hand.
- ...the [elder_thing] key loses 3 resources.

cards.name: August Lindquist
cards.text: [action]位于奥古斯特·林奎斯特所在地点的调查员共同花费2[per_investigator]个线索：谈判。每位花费了线索的调查员必须受到1点伤害或1点恐惧。将奥古斯特·林奎斯特从游戏中移除，并控制其钥匙。
cards.textEn: [action] Investigators at August Lindquist's location spend 2 [per_investigator] clues, as a group: Parley. Each investigator who spent at least 1 clue must either take 1 damage or 1 horror. Remove August Lindquist from the game and take control of his key.

cards.name: Puzzle Box
cards.text:
强制 - 在你被击败时：将机关盒的控制权给予另一位调查员。
[action]：熄灭你所在地点的火盆，横置幽灵看守人，或对幽灵看守人造成5点伤害(如果其已处于横置状态)。本行动不会触发幽灵看守人的趁乱攻击(团队每场游戏仅限一次。)
cards.textEn:
Forced - When you are defeated: Give control of the Puzzle Box to another investigator.
[action]: Unlight a brazier at your location, exhaust The Spectral Watcher, or deal 5 damage to The Spectral Watcher if it is exhausted. This action does not provoke attacks of opportunity from The Spectral Watcher. (Group limit once per game.)

cards.name: In the Clutches of Chaos
cards.text:
简单/普通
[skull]：-X。X为你所在地点的裂口和毁灭标记总数。
[cultist]：再揭示1个标记。如果你所在地点的裂口少于3个，在其上放置1个裂口。
[tablet]：-2。你检定失败且每低于难度1点，移除当前场景上的1个裂口。
[elder_thing]：-3。如果你检定失败，在随机1个地点上放置1个裂口。
cards.textEn:
Easy / Standard
[skull]: -X. X is the total amount of doom and breaches on your location.
[cultist]: Reveal another token. If there are fewer than 3 breaches on your location, place 1 breach on your location.
[tablet]: -2. For each point you fail by, remove 1 breach from the current act.
[elder_thing]: -3. If you fail, place 1 breach on a random location.

cards.name: THE CHARIOT · VII
cards.backText:
检查剧本日志。
- 如果安妮特·梅森被魔鬼附身，(→结局3)。
- 如果卡尔·桑福德知晓了宇宙之秘，(→结局4)。
cards.text:
强制 - 在毁灭标记将要放到本密谋上时：改为在数量等于调查员人数+1的随机不同地点上放置1个裂口。
强制 - 在裂口标记将要放到带有3个裂口的地点时：改为结算该地点的入侵一次。
cards.textEn:
Forced - When doom would be placed on this agenda: Instead, place 1 breach on a number of different random locations equal to 1 more than the number of investigators.
Forced - When a breach would be placed on a location with 3 breaches: Instead, resolve an incursion at that location.

cards.name: Chaos Manifest
cards.text: 显现 - 检定[willpower](3)。在X个不同的随机地点上放置1个裂口，其中X为你检定失败且低于检定难度的点数。
cards.textEn: Revelation - Test [willpower] (3). Place 1 breach on X different random locations, where X is the amount by which you failed.

cards.name: Primordial Gateway
cards.text:
显现 - 附属到一个随机地点。在所附属地点上放置裂口，直至该地点上有正好3个裂口。
将所附属地点的印刷文本框视为如同空白(除[[特性]]外)。
[action]：检定[intellect]或[willpower](4)以关闭通道。如果你成功，弃掉元初通道。
cards.textEn:
Revelation - Attach to a random location. Place breaches on attached location until there are exactly 3 breaches on it.
Treat the attached location as if its printed text box were blank (except for [[Traits]]).
[action]: Test [intellect] or [willpower] (4) to close the gateway. If you succeed, discard Primordial Gateway.

cards.name: Terror Unleashed
cards.text: 显现 - 如果你所在地点没有裂口，在其上放置1个裂口。你必须受到X点伤害或恐惧，由你自行分配，其中X为你所在地点上的裂口和毁灭标记总数。
cards.textEn: Revelation - If there are no breaches on your location, place 1 breach on your location. You must take X damage or horror, divided as you wish. X is the total amount of doom and breaches on your location.

cards.name: Terror in the Night
cards.text:
显现 - 检定[willpower](4)。如果你失败，将恐怖夜色放置入场，放在密谋牌库旁。如果你检定失败且低于难度至少3点，恐怖夜色获得涌动。
如果密谋牌库旁有3张恐怖夜色，将其全部弃掉，每位调查员受到3点恐惧。
cards.textEn:
Revelation - Test [willpower] (4). If you fail, put Terror in the Night into play next to the agenda deck. If you fail by 3 or more, Terror in the Night gains surge.
If there are 3 copies of Terror in the Night next to the agenda deck, discard them and each investigator takes 3 horror.

cards.name: Fate of All Fools
cards.text:
险境。
显现 - 你必须决定(选择一项)：
- 如果场上没有其他愚人的命运，将愚人的命运放置入场，放到你的威胁区域。
- 威胁区域中有另一张愚人的命运的一位调查员受到2点直接伤害。
- 在另一张愚人的命运上放置1个毁灭标记。
cards.textEn:
Peril.
Revelation - You must decide (choose one):
- If there is no other copy of Fate of All Fools in play, put Fate of All Fools into play in your threat area.
- An investigator with another copy of Fate of All Fools in his or her threat area takes 2 direct damage.
- Place 1 doom on another copy of Fate of All Fools.

cards.name: Dark Knowledge (v. I)
cards.text:
[free]移除本场景的3个裂口：在一个随机地点上放置1个线索。
目标 - 在调查员搜集的线索总计达到所需数量时，必须立即花费这些线索并推进场景。在本场景推进时，将上面所有的裂口移动到下一张场景。
cards.textEn:
[fast] Remove 3 breaches from this act: Place 1 clue on a random location.
Objective - When the investigators have collected the requisite number of clues, they must immediately spend them and advance. When this act advances, move all of the breaches on it to the next act.

cards.name: Anette Mason
cards.text:
生成 - 绞刑者山丘。
警戒。猎手。
调查员每控制1个线索，安妮特·梅森得到-2生命值。
强制 - 有裂口放置到安妮特·梅森所在地点上后：每位调查员必须受到1点伤害或1点恐惧。
cards.textEn:
Spawn - Hangman's Hill.
Alert. Hunter.
Anette Mason gets -2 health for each clue controlled by an investigator.
Forced - After 1 or more breaches are placed on Anette Mason's location: Each investigator must either take 1 damage or 1 horror.

cards.name: Beyond the Grave
cards.text:
[free]移除本场景的3个裂口：在一个随机地点上放置1个线索。
目标 - 如果安妮特·梅森被击败，推进场景。
cards.textEn:
[fast] Remove 3 breaches from this act: Place 1 clue on a random location.
Objective - If Anette Mason is defeated, advance.

cards.name: Witness of Chaos
cards.text:
生成 - 裂口最少的地点。
猎手。
强制 - 在混沌见证者进入一个地点后：在该地点上放置1个裂口。
cards.textEn:
Spawn - Fewest breaches.
Hunter.
Forced - After Witness of Chaos enters a location: Place 1 breach on that location.

cards.name: Toil and Trouble
cards.text:
险境。
显现 - 你必须(选择一项)：
- 结算遭遇弃牌堆最顶部的[[力量]]诡计上的显现能力。
- 结算你所在地点的入侵一次。
cards.textEn:
Peril.
Revelation - You must either (choose one):
- Resolve the revelation ability on the topmost [[Power]] treachery in the encounter discard pile.
- Resolve an incursion at your location.

cards.name: Realm of Torment
cards.text:
显现 - 将苦痛之地放置入场，放到你的威胁区域。
强制 - 在你的回合开始时：结算你所在地点的每个闹鬼能力。
强制 - 在你的回合结束时：检定[willpower](3)。如果你检定成功，弃掉苦痛之地。
cards.textEn:
Revelation - Put Realm of Torment into play in your threat area.
Forced - When your turn begins: Resolve each haunted ability on your location.
Forced - When your turn ends: Test [willpower] (3). If you succeed, discard Realm of Torment.

cards.name: Shapes in the Mist
cards.text:
涌动。
显现 - 结算你所在地点的每个闹鬼能力。
cards.textEn:
Surge.
Revelation - Resolve each haunted ability on your location.

cards.name: Dark Knowledge (v. II)
cards.text:
[free]移除本场景的3个裂口：在一个随机地点上放置1个线索。
目标 - 在调查员搜集的线索总计达到所需数量时，必须立即花费这些线索并推进场景。在本场景推进时，将上面所有的裂口移动到下一张场景。
cards.textEn:
[fast] Remove 3 breaches from this act: Place 1 clue on a random location.
Objective - When the investigators have collected the requisite number of clues, they must immediately spend them and advance. When this act advances, move all of the breaches on it to the next act.

cards.name: Carl Sanford
cards.text:
生成 - 银暮秘社。
猎手。反击。
调查员每控制1个线索，卡尔·桑福德生命值-2。
强制 - 在任意数量的裂口被从当前场景移除后：将其中1个放在卡尔·桑福德所在地点。
cards.textEn:
Spawn - Silver Twilight Lodge.
Hunter. Retaliate.
Carl Sanford gets -2 health for each clue controlled by an investigator.
Forced - After any number of breaches are removed from the current act: Place 1 of them on Carl Sanford's location.

cards.name: New World Order
cards.text:
[free]移除本场景的3个裂口：在一个随机地点上放置1个线索。
目标 - 如果卡尔·桑福德被击败，推进场景。
cards.textEn:
[fast] Remove 3 breaches from this act: Place 1 clue on a random location.
Objective - If Carl Sanford is defeated, advance.

cards.name: Lodge Enforcer
cards.text:
生成 - 裂口最多的地点(如果场上地点均无裂口，生成在银暮秘社)。
反击。
将秘社打手所在地点的印刷文本框视为如同空白(除[[特性]]外)。
cards.textEn:
Spawn - Most breaches (or Silver Twilight Lodge if there are no locations in play with breaches on them).
Retaliate.
Treat Lodge Enforcer's location as if its printed text box were blank (except for [[Traits]]).

cards.name: Secrets of the Beyond
cards.text: 显现 - 找出场上毁灭标记最多的[[异教徒]]敌人。该敌人身上每有1个毁减标记，在该敌人的地点上放置1个裂口。如果未因本效果放置裂口，异界之秘获得涌动。
cards.textEn: Revelation - Find the [[Cultist]] enemy in play with the most doom on it. For each doom on that enemy, place 1 breach on that enemy's location. If no breaches are placed by this effect, Secrets of the Beyond gains surge.

cards.name: Lodge Neophyte
cards.text:
生成 - 任意无人地点。
冷漠。
强制 - 在秘社新信徒入场后：在上面放置1个毁灭标记。
[action]：谈判。检定[willpower](2)。如果你检定成功，移除秘社新信徒上的所有毁灭标记。
cards.textEn:
Spawn - Any empty location.
Aloof.
Forced - After Lodge Neophyte enters play: Place 1 doom on it.
[action]: Parley. Test [willpower] (2). If you succeed, remove all doom from Lodge Neophyte.

cards.name: Keeper of Secrets
cards.text:
生成 - 任意无人地点。
冷漠。反击。
强制 - 在神话阶段结束时：在守密人上放置1个毁灭标记。
[action]：谈判。检定[intellect](3)。如果你检定成功，移除守密人上的所有毁灭标记。
cards.textEn:
Spawn - Any empty location.
Aloof. Retaliate.
Forced - When the mythos phase ends: Place 1 doom on Keeper of Secrets.
[action]: Parley. Test [intellect] (3). If you succeed, remove all doom from Keeper of Secrets.

cards.name: Mysteries of the Lodge
cards.text: 显现 - 在最近的一个[[异教徒]]敌人身上放置1个毁灭标记。然后，直到一轮结束，对该敌人攻击、躲避或与该敌人谈判的难度加2。如果未因本效果放置毁灭标记，秘社玄仪获得涌动。
cards.textEn: Revelation - Place 1 doom on the nearest [[Cultist]] enemy. Then, until the end of the round, increase the difficulty to fight, evade, or parley with that enemy by 2. If no doom is placed by this effect, Mysteries of the Lodge gains surge.

cards.name: Nether Mist
cards.text:
猎物 - 所在地点线索最多的调查员。
冷漠。猎手。
冥府之雾所在地点获得：“闹鬼 - 冥府之雾攻击你。”
cards.textEn:
Prey - Investigator at the location with the most clues.
Aloof. Hunter.
Nether Mist's location gains: "Haunted - Nether Mist attacks you."

cards.name: Shadow Hound
cards.text:
猎物 - [agility]最低。
猎手。反击。
强制 - 在暗影猎犬攻击你后：结算你所在地点的每个闹鬼能力。
cards.textEn:
Prey - Lowest [agility].
Hunter. Retaliate.
Forced - After Shadow Hound attacks you: Resolve each haunted ability on your location.

cards.name: Whispers in the Dark
cards.text:
显现 - 将黑暗中的低语放置入场，放在密谋牌库旁边。
每个地点获得：“闹鬼 - 受到1点恐惧。”
强制 - 在一轮结束时：弃掉黑暗中的低语。
cards.textEn:
Revelation - Put Whispers in the Dark into play next to the agenda deck.
Each location gains: "Haunted - Take 1 horror."
Forced - When the round ends: Discard Whispers in the Dark.

cards.name: The Secret Name
cards.text:
简单/普通
[skull]：-1(如果你位于[[异次元]]地点，改为-3)。
[cultist]：再揭示一个混乱标记。如果你检定失败，弃掉遭遇牌库顶3张卡牌。
[tablet]：-2。如果你检定失败，且那赫卜在你的地点，其攻击你。
[elder_thing]：-3。如果你检定失败，结算场上每个敌人的猎手关键词。
cards.textEn:
Easy / Standard
[skull]: -1 (-3 instead if you are at an [[Extradimensional]] location).
[cultist]: Reveal another chaos token. If you fail, discard the top 3 cards of the encounter deck.
[tablet]: -2. If you fail and Nahab is at your location, she attacks you.
[elder_thing]: -3. If you fail, resolve the hunter keyword on each enemy in play.

cards.name: THE HERMIT • IX
cards.backText:
如果布朗·詹金在场，查找遭遇牌库和弃牌堆，找出一张鼠群，并将其生成在布朗·詹金所在地点。如果布朗·詹金不在场，查找遭遇牌库和遭遇弃牌堆，将其找出，并将其生成在调查员队长所在地点。
除此之外，如果游戏中有3或4位调查员，查找遭遇牌库和遭遇弃牌堆，找出一张鼠群，并将其生成在任意一个[[巫宅]]地点。
cards.text:
每个非弱点敌人得到+1生命值。
[reaction]在你击败布朗·詹金或那赫卜后：从供应堆获得1个线索(如果游戏中有至少3位调查员，改为获得2个线索)。
cards.textEn:
Each non-weakness enemy gets +1 health.
[reaction] After you defeat Brown Jenkin or Nahab: Gain 1 clue from the token bank (2 clues instead if there are 3 or more investigators in the game).

cards.name: The Familiar
cards.backText:
- 如果当前为场景1，将放在一边的那赫卜生成在沃尔特·吉尔曼的房间。
- 如果当前为场景2，将放在一边的那赫卜生成在凯夏的房间。
- 如果当前为场景3，在那赫卜上放置1个毁灭标记。
将放在一边的2张鬼影骤现洗入遭遇牌库。找出布朗·詹金(不论其是否位于场上)，将其放在那赫卜当前所在地点。
cards.text:
每个非弱点敌人得到+2生命值。
[reaction]在你击败布朗·詹金或那赫卜后：从供应堆获得1个线索(如果游戏中有至少3位调查员，改为获得2个线索)。
cards.textEn:
Each non-weakness enemy gets +2 health.
[reaction] After you defeat Brown Jenkin or Nahab: Gain 1 clue from the token bank (2 clues instead if there are 3 or more investigators in the game).

cards.name: The Witch Light
cards.backText:
- 如果当前为场景1或场景2，将那赫卜放在一边，位于场外，且密谋4a入场时在密谋4a上面放置4个毁灭标记。
- 如果当前为场景3，在那赫卜上放置1个毁灭标记。
cards.text:
每个非弱点敌人得到+3生命值。
[reaction]在你击败布朗·詹金或那赫卜后：从供应堆获得1个线索(如果游戏中有至少3位调查员，改为获得2个线索)。
cards.textEn:
Each non-weakness enemy gets +3 health.
[reaction] After you defeat Brown Jenkin or Nahab: Gain 1 clue from the token bank (2 clues instead if there are 3 or more investigators in the game).

cards.name: Marked for Sacrifice
cards.text:
每个非弱点敌人得到+4生命值。
[reaction]在你击败布朗·詹金或那赫卜后：从供应堆获得1个线索(如果游戏中有至少3位调查员，改为获得2个线索)。
cards.textEn:
Each non-weakness enemy gets +4 health.
[reaction] After you defeat Brown Jenkin or Nahab: Gain 1 clue (2 clues instead if there are 3 or more investigators in the game).

cards.name: Investigating the Witch House
cards.backText:
用放在一边的凯夏的房间替换沃尔特·吉尔曼的房间(原地点上的所有标记和卡牌现在都在新地点上)。将场上的其他所有地点从游戏中移除。
选择一位调查员来控制放在一边的黑书支援。将放在一边的2张古怪图形洗入遭遇牌库。
cards.text: 目标 - 如果所有未被击败的调查员都位于沃尔特·吉尔曼的房间，调查员可以共同花费所需数量的线索以推进场景。
cards.textEn: Objective - If each undefeated investigator is in Walter Gilman's Room, investigators may spend the requisite number of clues, as a group, to advance.

cards.name: Beyond the Witch House
cards.backText:
将放在一边的献祭场所地点放置入场。
- 如果当前为密谋1、密谋2或密谋3，找出那赫卜(不论其是否在场)，在其上放置2个毁灭标记，并将其放在献祭场所。
- 如果当前为密谋4，找出那赫卜(不论其是否在场)，并将其放在献祭场所。将密谋4a上的每个毁灭标记移动到那赫卜身上。
找出布朗·詹金(不论他是否位于场上)，将其放在那赫卜当前所在地点。
cards.text: 目标 - 只有在巫宅遗址的调查员可以共同花费所需数量的线索以推进场景。
cards.textEn: Objective - Only investigators in the Witch House Ruins may spend the requisite number of clues, as a group, to advance.

cards.name: Stopping the Ritual
cards.text:
那赫卜不能离开献祭场所。
强制 - 在那赫卜被击败时：不将其弃掉，改为治愈其所有伤害，将其与所有调查员解除交战状态并将其横置。本轮补给阶段期间其不重整。
目标 - 如果那赫卜上没有毁灭标记，推进场景。
cards.textEn:
Nahab cannot leave the Site of the Sacrifice.
Forced - When Nahab is defeated: Instead of discarding her, heal all damage from her, disengage her from all investigators, and exhaust her. She does not ready during the upkeep phase this round.
Objective - If there is no doom on Nahab, advance.

cards.name: Frank Elwood's room
cards.nameZh: 弗兰克·埃尔伍德的房间

cards.name: Walter Gilman's Room
cards.backText: 沃尔特·吉尔曼的房间锁上了。作为进入沃尔特·吉尔曼的房间的额外费用，位于发霉的走道的调查员必须共同花费1[per_investigator]个线索。

cards.name: Court of the Great Old Ones
Meddlesome Familiar
cards.text: 显现 - 如果布朗·詹金不在场，查找遭遇牌库和遭遇弃牌堆，将其找出，并将其生成在你所在地点，且你受到1点伤害。否则，查找遭遇牌库和遭遇弃牌堆，找出一张鼠群并将其生成，与你交战，然后你受到1点伤害。
cards.textEn: Revelation - If Brown Jenkin is not in play, search the encounter deck and discard pile for him, spawn him at your location, and take 1 damage. Otherwise, search the encounter deck and discard pile for a Swarm of Rats, spawn it engaged with you, then take 1 damage.

cards.name: Ghostly Presence
cards.text: 显现 - 如果那赫卜在场上，将其重整，结算其猎手关键词，且其攻击自己所在地点的每位调查员。如果那赫卜位于献祭场所，则再在其身上放置1个毁灭标记。否则，查找遭遇牌库和遭遇弃牌堆，找出那赫卜并将其生成在你所在地点。
cards.textEn: Revelation - If Nahab is in play, ready her, resolve her hunter keyword, and she attacks each investigator at her location. If Nahab is at the Site of the Sacrifice, place 1 doom on her, as well. Otherwise, search the encounter deck and discard pile for Nahab and spawn her at your location.

cards.name: Extradimensional Visions
cards.text: 显现 - 检定[willpower](2)。遭遇弃牌堆每有10张卡牌，本次检定难度+1。如果你检定失败，弃掉一个你控制的支援。
cards.textEn: Revelation - Test [willpower] (2). This test gets +1 difficulty for every 10 cards in the encounter discard pile. If you fail, discard an asset you control.

cards.name: Pulled by the Stars
cards.text:
显现 - 将群星牵引放置入场，放到你的威胁区域。
强制 - 当你回合结束时，如果你本回合期间未移动过：受到2点恐惧。
[action]：检定[willpower](3)。如果你检定成功，将群星牵引从场上弃掉。如果你所在地点有处于横置状态的[[女巫]]敌人，本次检定自动成功。
cards.textEn:
Revelation - Put Pulled by the Stars into play in your threat area.
Forced - At the end of your turn, if you did not move at least once during your turn: Take 2 horror.
[action]: Test [willpower] (3). If you succeed, discard Pulled by the Stars from play. If there is an exhausted [[Witch]] enemy at your location, this test is automatically successful.

cards.name: Disquieting Dreams
cards.text:
显现 - 检定[willpower](5)。如果你检定失败，将不安的梦放置入场，放到你的威胁区域。
强制 - 当你的回合结束时：弃掉遭遇牌库顶的1张卡牌。
强制 - 在遭遇牌库的卡牌耗尽时：弃掉不安的梦并揭示你牌堆顶10张卡牌。抽取每张揭示的弱点，并弃掉其他每张揭示的卡牌。
cards.textEn:
Revelation - Test [willpower] (5). If you fail, put Disquieting Dreams into play in your threat area.
Forced - At the end of your turn: Discard the top card of the encounter deck.
Forced - When the encounter deck runs out of cards: Discard Disquieting Dreams and reveal the top 10 cards of your deck. Draw each weakness revealed and discard each other revealed card.

cards.name: Brown Jenkin
cards.text:
冷漠。猎手。
每个处于重整状态的[[生物]]敌人得到+2攻击。
强制 - 在敌军阶段结束时，如果布朗·詹金处于重整状态：其所在地点上的每位调查员弃掉自己的所有手牌，然后抽取等量卡牌。
cards.textEn:
Aloof. Hunter.
Each ready [[Creature]] enemy gets +2 fight.
Forced - When the enemy phase ends, if Brown Jenkin is ready: Each investigator at his location discards his or her hand, then draws that many cards.

cards.name: Nahab
cards.text:
猎手。反击。
在密谋推进时，不要移除那赫卜的毁灭标记。
那赫卜得到+X攻击，其中X为当前密谋编号。
强制 - 在敌军阶段开始后，如果那赫卜处于重整状态：在其上放置1个毁灭标记。
cards.textEn:
Hunter. Retaliate.
Do not remove doom from Nahab when the agenda advances.
Nahab gets +X fight, where X is the number of the current agenda.
Forced - After the enemy phase begins, if Nahab is ready: Place 1 doom on her.

cards.name: The Black Book
cards.text:
你得到+1[willpower]和+1[intellect]。
[reaction]在你打出一张卡牌时，横置黑书并受到X点恐惧：该卡牌的费用减少X点。
cards.textEn:
You get +1 [willpower] and +1 [intellect].
[reaction] When you play a card, exhaust The Black Book and take X horror: Reduce that card's cost by X.

cards.name: The Wages of Sin
cards.text:
简单/普通
[skull]：-X。X为胜利牌区中未了之事的数量+1。
[cultist]：-3。直到一轮结束，场上每个异端者敌人得到+1攻击和+1躲避。
[tablet]：-3。如果你检定失败，触发你威胁区域中一张未了之事上的强制能力，如同此时是一轮结束。
[elder_thing]：-2。如果你检定失败且本次检定为攻击或躲避尝试，结算你所在地点的每个闹鬼能力。
cards.textEn:
Easy / Standard
[skull]: -X. X is 1 higher than the number of copies of Unfinished Business in the victory display.
[cultist]: -3. Until the end of the round, each Heretic enemy in play gets +1 fight and +1 evade.
[tablet]: -3. If you fail, trigger the forced ability on a copy of Unfinished Business in yout threat area as if it were the end of the round.
[elder_thing]: -2. If you fail and this is an attack or evasion attempt, resolve each haunted ability on your location.

cards.name: THE HANGED MAN · XII
cards.backText:
将每个地点翻到其[[幽灵]]面。
将放在一边的幽灵看守人敌人放置入场，放到绞刑者河。
将放在一边的看守人遭遇组的剩余卡牌和幽灵遭遇弃牌堆一同洗入幽灵遭遇牌库。

cards.name: Death's Approach
cards.text: 地点不能被翻到非[[幽灵]]面。(FAQ，v1.6)
cards.textEn: Locations cannot be flipped to their non-[[Spectral]] side.

cards.name: In Pursuit of the Dead
cards.backText:
在以下每个地点生成放在一边的1个异端者敌人：绞刑架、异端者的墓地、教堂阁楼、教堂地下室。在上述每个地点增加2[per_investigator]个线索。在其他每个地点增加1[per_investigator]个线索。
检查剧本日志。如果列在“遗留记忆”下方的遗物大于等于3个：你听懂了女巫所唱歌曲中的悲伤歌词。每位调查员将1张放在一边的幽灵迷网支援放置入场，置于自己控制之下。
cards.text: 地点不能被翻到[[幽灵]]面。(FAQ，v1.6)
cards.textEn: Locations cannot be flipped to their [[Spectral]] side.

cards.name: In Pursuit of the Living
cards.backText:
在剧本日志“遗留记忆”下方记录下玉米皮娃娃。
(→结局1)
cards.text:
[free]：将你所在地点翻面。(团队每轮在每个地点仅限一次。)
线索不能在非[[幽灵]]地点被发现。
目标 - 驱除尽可能多的异端者。如果胜利牌区中有4张未了之事，推进场景。
cards.textEn:
[fast]: Flip your location over. (Group limit once per round at each location.)
Clues cannot be discovered at non-[[Spectral]] locations.
Objective - Banish as many Heretics as you can. If there are 4 copies of Unfinished Business in the victory display, advance.

cards.name: Spectral Web
cards.text: [action]你所在地点的调查员共同花费1-3个线索：攻击。本能力只能用于攻击[[灵怪]]敌人。你本次攻击中可以选择不使用[combat]，改为使用[willpower]。本次攻击你得到技能值+X，并造成+X伤害，其中X为触发本能力所花费的线索数量。
cards.textEn: [action] Investigators at your location spend 1-3 clues, as a group: Fight. Use this ability only to attack a [[Geist]] enemy. You may choose to use your [willpower] instead of your [combat] for this attack. You get +X skill value and deal +X damage for this attack, where X is the amount of clues spent to trigger this ability.

cards.name: Heretic
cards.text:
异端者得到+2[per_investigator]生命值。
异端者位于非[[幽灵]]地点时，其获得冷漠且不能被交战也不能受到伤害。
[free]花费1个线索：谈判。查看异端者的另一面(不要结算其文字)。
强制 - 异端者被击败后：将其翻面并结算另一面的文本。
cards.textEn:
Heretic gets +2 [per_investigator] health.
While Heretic is at a non-[[Spectral]] location, it gains aloof and cannot be engaged or damaged.
[fast] Spend 1 clue: Parley. Look at Heretic's other side (without resolving its text).
Forced - After Heretic is defeated: Flip it over and resolve the text on its other side.

cards.name: Unfinished Business
cards.text:
她呻吟，哀伤地哭泣着，徒劳地鸣咽个不停。一定有什么办法能让她冷静下来。
将本卡牌保留在你的威胁区域(以本面朝上)。如果你退场，将其翻面。
强制 - 当一轮结束时：你必须受到1点恐惧或将本卡牌翻回敌人面。
[action]如果你位于教堂地下室，且其上没有线索：[intellect]或[combat](4)。如果你检定成功，本幽灵被“驱除”(结算以下文本)。
本幽灵被“驱除”之前，请勿阅读下文。
你找到一具无名棺材，移开棺盖。幽灵仍记得心中所爱，她哭着伸出手去，想要触碰棺材里的尸体。
将本卡牌加入胜利牌区。
cards.textEn:
The thing moans and wails with sorrow, in between hollow, echoing sobs. There must be some way you can bring it peace.
Keep this card in your threat area (this side faceup). If you are eliminated, flip it over.
Forced - At the end of the round: You must either take 1 horror or flip this card back to its enemy side.
[action] If you are at Chapel Crypt and it has no clues on it: Test [intellect] or [combat] (4). If you succeed, the ghost is "banished" (resolve the text below).
Do not read until this ghost is "banished."
You find a nameless coffin and remove the lid. The spirit weeps as it reaches out to touch the body inside, remembering the love it once held in its heart.
Add this card to the victory display.

cards.name: Heretic
cards.text:
异端者得到+2[per_investigator]生命值。
异端者位于非[[幽灵]]地点时，其获得冷漠且不能被交战也不能受到伤害。
[free]花费1个线索：谈判。查看异端者的另一面(不要结算其文字)。
强制 - 异端者被击败后：将其翻面并结算另一面的文本。
cards.textEn:
Heretic gets +2 [per_investigator] health.
While Heretic is at a non-[[Spectral]] location, it gains aloof and cannot be engaged or damaged.
[fast] Spend 1 clue: Parley. Look at Heretic's other side (without resolving its text).
Forced - After Heretic is defeated: Flip it over and resolve the text on its other side.

cards.name: Unfinished Business
cards.text:
被烧焦的鬼魂彷佛经受着无尽的折磨，痛苦地捶打、嚎叫。你无法减轻她的痛苦，但或许你能为她伸张正义。
将本卡牌保留在你的威胁区域(以本面朝上)。如果你退场，将其翻面。
强制 - 当一轮结束时：你必须受到1点恐惧或将本卡牌翻回敌人面。
[action]如果你位于绞刑架，且其上没有线索：检定[willpower]或[agility](4)。如果你检定成功，本幽灵被“驱除”(结算以下文本)。
本幽灵被“驱除”之前，请勿阅读下文。
火势迅速蔓延，饿极了似的吞噬了绞刑架那古老的木质平台。幽灵诡异地表达自己的心满意足，身躯抽动着。
将本卡牌加入胜利牌区。
cards.textEn:
The charred ghost thrashes and howls in agony, as though in a constant state of torment. You cannot ease its suffering, but perhaps you can bring it justice.
Keep this card in your threat area (this side faceup). If you are eliminated, flip it over.
Forced - At the end of the round: You must either take 1 damage or flip this card back to its enemy side.

cards.name: Ominous Portents

cards.textEn:
Peril.
Revelation - You must either (choose one):
- Draw the top card of the spectral encounter deck. That card gains peril, and its effects cannot be canceled.
- Test [willpower] (3). If you fail take 2 horror.

cards.name: Grave-Light

cards.textEn:

- ...from the standard encounter deck, shuffle it into the spectral encounter deck, and it gains surge.
- ...from the spectral encounter deck, take 2 damage and place it in the standard encounter discard pile.

cards.name: Bane of the Living

cards.textEn:
Peril.
Revelation - You must either (choose one):
- Choose an Unfinished Business card in play, flip it to its Heretic side, and place damage on it equal to half its health.

cards.textEn:
Alert. Hunter.
Forced - When The Spectral Watcher is defeated: Instead of discarding it, heal all damage from it, disengage it from all investigators, and exhaust it. It does not ready during the upkeep phase this round.

cards.name: Watcher's Grasp
cards.text: 显现 - 治愈幽灵看守人的3点伤害。重整幽灵看守人。其移动、交战并攻击，如同此刻是敌军阶段。结算本效果期间，幽灵看守人获得“猎物 - 你。”
cards.textEn: Revelation - Heal 3 damage from The Spectral Watcher. Ready The Spectral Watcher. It moves, engages, and attacks as if it were the enemy phase. Throughout the resolution of this effect, The Spectral Watcher gains "Prey - You."

cards.name: The Witching Hour
cards.text:

[skull]：-1。你检定失败且每低于难度1点，弃掉遭遇牌库顶1张卡牌。

cards.name: TEMPERANCE • XIV

cards.name: The Night Howls

cards.text: 强制 - 当一轮结束时：女巫圆环每有一个[[女巫]]敌人，在本密谋上放置1个毁灭标记。

cards.name: Lost in the Woods

每位调查员必须随机选择1张放在一边的阿卡姆密林地点里，将其放置入场，放到自己面前，并且立即移动到该地点(不能取消)。
每位调查员将放在一边的一个黑山羊眷族生成到自己所在地点(如果是4人游戏，改为调查员队长将放在一边的一个坚韧的黑山羊幼崽生成，其他每位调查员将放在一边的一个黑山羊眷族生成)。然后每位调查员检定[willpower]或[agility](3)。检定成功的每位调查员横置与自己交战的该敌人并且解除交战。
将放在一边的1张魔鬼的笛声洗入遭遇牌库。将另外2张魔鬼的笛声放到遭遇弃牌堆。
cards.text:
你面前的地点均相互连接。你不能进入其他调查员面前的地点。
目标 - 当一轮结束时，调查员可以以团队为单位，花费所需数量的线索以推进场景。
cards.textEn:
Locations in front of you are connected to one another. You cannot enter locations in front of other investigators.

cards.name: Witch Hauntings

cards.text:

cards.name: Paths into Twilight

cards.name: A Circle Unbroken

如果你通过击败安妮特·梅森推进场景：
“住手！”女巫集会的领导者以命令的语气喝道，表情因为你造成的伤口而痛苦扭曲。你不确定她是喝止你还是喝止包围你的那群兜帽女子，但无论如何，圆环四周突然陷入了寂静。

如果你通过发现女巫圆环的所有线索推进场景：

(→结局2)
cards.text:
你面前的地点均相互连接。

Objective - If there are no clues on the Witches' Circle, advance.

cards.name: Anette Mason

cards.name: Wraith

猎手。

cards.name: Union and Disillusion

cards.name: THE LOVERS · VI
cards.backText:

在鬼灵迷雾的另一头，一声恐怖的尖叫在树林里回响。那声音很遥远，像是隔着一面玻璃传来的，但又是那么的清晰，令你知道这声音是真实存在的。
每有一个角色被看守人抓走，在幽灵看守人身上放置1资源，作为1个被偷走的灵魂(不论幽灵看守人当前是否在场)。
直到冒险结束，幽灵看守人获得以下文本：“幽灵看守人上每有一个被偷走的灵魂，其得到+1攻击值，+1[per_investigator]生命值。”将本卡牌放在密谋牌库旁作为提示，并推进至密谋2a。

cards.name: The Unvisited Isle

每位调查员必须随机选择1张放在一边的未访之岛地点，将其放置入场，放到自己面前，并且立即移动到该地点(不能取消)。如果调查员支持女巫集会，位于这些所选地点的火盆已点燃。在这些所选地点上放置1个资源标记以作表示。

cards.text: 每位调查员不能离开自己面前的地点。

cards.name: Gavriella Mizrah
cards.text:
你得到+1[combat]。
[reaction]敌人攻击你后，即便该次攻击被取消，横置加弗瑞拉·米兹拉克：发现你所在地点的1个线索。
cards.textEn:
You get +1 [combat].
[reaction] After an enemy attacks you, even if that attack was canceled, exhaust Gavriella Mizrah: Discover 1 clue at your location.

cards.name: Jerome Davids
cards.text:
你得到+1[intellect]。
[reaction]在你地点的一位调查员从遭遇牌库抽出诡计卡时，横置杰罗姆·戴维斯并弃掉你至少总计带有2个[intellect]图标的手牌：取消该卡牌的显现效果。
cards.textEn:
You get +1 [intellect].
[reaction] When an investigator at your location draws a treachery from the encounter deck, exhaust Jerome Davids and discard cards from your hand with a total of at least 2 [intellect] icons: Cancel that card's revelation effect.

cards.text:

[reaction]你在显现效果期间的技能检定成功后，横置佩妮·怀特：发现你所在地点的1个线索。
cards.textEn:
You get +1 [willpower].
[reaction] After you succeed at a skill test during a revelation effect, exhaust Penny White: Discover 1 clue at your location.

cards.text:

[free]在你执行的技能检定期间，花费2资源并横置瓦伦蒂诺·里瓦斯：本次检定难度降低1点。
cards.textEn:
You get +1 [agility].
[fast] During a skill test you are performing, spend 2 resources and exhaust Valentino Rivas: Reduce the difficulty of this test by 1.

cards.name: Gavriella's Fate
cards.text:
检查剧本日志的“失踪人口”区域。如果加弗瑞拉消失在迷雾之中并且调查员正在追查加弗瑞拉：
加弗瑞拉从雾中跌出，眼睛血红，紧张地说：“我在哪？……你是谁？”
控制放在一边的加弗瑞拉·米兹拉克剧情支援卡。她不占用盟友槽，直到本场冒险结束。在“失踪人员”的加弗瑞拉·米兹拉克旁边记录加弗瑞拉还活着。如果加弗瑞拉已被幽灵夺走性命：
将本卡牌翻回敌人面，将其生成在你所在地点。如果调查员正在追查加弗瑞拉，其生成时被横置并且不处于交战状态。否则，其生成时与你交战。否则：
你发现加弗瑞拉的武器落在草丛里，已经腐坏、破烂。而她本人不见踪影。
cards.textEn:
Check the "Missing Persons" section of the Campaign Log. If Gavriella disappeared into the mist and you are on Gavriella's trail:
Gavriella stumbles out of the mist, her eyes bloodshot and her voice strained. "Where am I?… Who are you?"
Take control of the set-aside Gavriella Mizrah story asset. For the remainder of this scenario, she does not take up an ally slot. Next to Gavriella Mizrah's profile, record Gavriella is alive.If Gavriella was claimed by specters:
Flip this card to its enemy side and spawn it at your location. If you are on Gavriella's trail, it spawns exhausted and unengaged. Otherwise, it spawns engaged with you.Otherwise:
You find Gavriella's weapon lying in the grass, decayed and broken. No other sign of her can be seen.

cards.name: Gavriella Mizrah
cards.text:
警戒。猎手。
强制 - 在你成功攻击加弗瑞拉·米兹拉克后，如果她处于重整状态：受到1点恐惧。
cards.textEn:
Alert. Hunter.
Forced - After you successfully attack Gavriella Mizrah, if she is ready: Take 1 horror.

cards.name: Jerome's Fate
cards.text:
检查剧本日志的“失踪人口”区域。如果杰罗姆消失在迷雾之中并且调查员正在追查杰罗姆：
杰罗姆从雾中爬出，你扶着他起身。“我的天啊……那雾……”他低声说道，“一切都有联系……一切都有联系……”
控制放在一边的杰罗姆·戴维斯剧情支援卡。他不占用盟友槽，直到本场冒险结束。在“失踪人员”的杰罗姆·戴维斯旁边记录杰罗姆还活着。如果杰罗姆已被幽灵夺走性命：
将本卡牌翻回敌人面，将其生成在你所在地点。如果调查员正在追查杰罗姆，其生成时被横置并且不处于交战状态。否则，其生成时与你交战。否则：
你从地上找到了一张来自杰罗姆随身笔记的纸片。上面只写着两个字：“救命！”
cards.textEn:
Check the "Missing Persons" section of the Campaign Log. If Jerome disappeared into the mist and you are on Jerome's trail:
Jerome crawls out of the mist, and you help him to his feet. "Oh god… the mist…" he whispers. "It's all connected… It's all connected…"
Take control of the set-aside Jerome Davids story asset. For the remainder of this scenario, he does not take up an ally slot. Next to Jerome Davids's profile, record Jerome is alive.If Jerome was claimed by specters:
Flip this card to its enemy side and spawn it at your location. If you are on Jerome's trail, it spawns exhausted and unengaged. Otherwise, it spawns engaged with you.Otherwise:
You find a scrap of paper from Jerome's pocket notebook on the ground. It simply reads: "HELP"

cards.name: Jerome Davids
cards.text:
猎手。
强制 - 在杰罗姆·戴维斯与你交战后：选择并弃掉你2张手牌。
cards.textEn:
Hunter.
Forced - After Jerome Davids engages you: Choose and discard 2 cards from your hand.

cards.name: Penny's Fate
cards.text:
检查剧本日志的“失踪人口”区域。如果佩妮消失在迷雾之中并且调查员正在追查佩妮：
佩妮险些把你撞了个满怀。你护着她的时候，她全身都在颤抖。“你、你活着吗？”她哭着说，“噩梦终于结束了吗？”
控制放在一边的佩妮·怀特剧情支援卡。她不占用盟友槽，直到本场冒险结束。在“失踪人员”的佩妮·怀特旁边记录佩妮还活着。如果佩妮已被幽灵夺走性命：
将本卡牌翻回敌人面，将其生成在你所在地点。如果调查员正在追查佩妮，其生成时被横置并且不处于交战状态。否则，其生成时与你交战。否则：
你在地上发现了佩妮的围裙，被血液染红，而她本人不见踪影。
cards.textEn:
Check the "Missing Persons" section of the Campaign Log. If Penny disappeared into the mist and you are on Penny's trail:
Penny nearly runs directly into you. Her whole body shakes with panic as you hold her safe. "A-are you alive?" she cries. "Is this nightmare finally over?"
Take control of the set-aside Penny White story asset. For the remainder of this scenario, she does not take up an ally slot. Next to Penny White's profile, record Penny is alive.If Penny was claimed by specters:
Flip this card to its enemy side and spawn it at your location. If you are on Penny's trail, it spawns exhausted and unengaged. Otherwise, it spawns engaged with you.Otherwise:
You find Penny's apron lying on the ground, covered in blood. There is no other sign of her.

cards.name: Penny White
cards.text:
猎手。
强制 - 在你成功躲避佩妮·怀特后：受到1点伤害。
cards.textEn:
Hunter.
Forced - After you successfully evade Penny White: Take 1 damage.

cards.name: Valentino's Fate
cards.text:
检查剧本日志的“失踪人口”区域。如果瓦伦蒂诺消失在迷雾之中并且调查员正在追查瓦伦蒂诺：
瓦伦蒂诺一瘸一拐地走出迷雾，倚在附近一棵树上。他发现你时，发出了病态的笑声。“救兵终于来了，对吗？”
控制放在一边的瓦伦蒂诺·里瓦斯剧情支持卡。他不占用盟友槽，直到本场冒险结束。在“失踪人员”的瓦伦蒂诺·里瓦斯旁边记录瓦伦蒂诺还活着。如果瓦伦蒂诺已被幽灵夺走性命：
将本卡牌翻回敌人面，将其生成在你所在地点。如果调查员正在追查瓦伦蒂诺，其生成时被横置并且不处于交战状态。否则，其生成时与你交战。否则：
瓦伦蒂诺的手杖落在淤泥里，几乎断成两半。手杖把手沾着陈旧的血迹。
cards.textEn:
Check the "Missing Persons" section of the Campaign Log. If Valentino disappeared into the mist and you are on Valentino's trail:
Valentino limps out of the mist, leaning on a nearby tree. He chuckles morbidly as he spots you. "Cavalry's finally here, eh?"
Take control of the set-aside Valentino Rivas story asset. For the remainder of this scenario, he does not take up an ally slot. Next to Valentino Rivas's profile, record Valentino is alive.If Valentino was claimed by specters:
Flip this card to its enemy side and spawn it at your location. If you are on Valentino's trail, it spawns exhausted and unengaged. Otherwise, it spawns engaged with you.Otherwise:
Valentino's cane lies in the mud, cracked nearly in half. Its handle is stained with old blood.

cards.name: Valentino Rivas
cards.text:
猎手。反击。
强制 - 在瓦伦蒂诺·里瓦斯与你交战后：失去2个资源。
cards.textEn:
Hunter. Retaliate.
Forced - After Valentino Rivas engages you: Lose 2 resources.

cards.name: Whippoorwill
cards.text:
冷漠。猎手。
夜鹰所在地点的调查员得到-1[willpower]、-1[intellect]、-1[combat]和-1[agility]。
cards.textEn:
Aloof. Hunter.
Each investigator at Whippoorwill's location gets -1 [willpower], -1 [intellect], -1 [combat], and -1 [agility].

cards.name: Spectral Raven
cards.text:
猎物 - [intellect]最低。
警戒。猎手。反击。
强制 - 在幽灵乌鸦与你交战后：你必须结算你所在地点的每个闹鬼能力，或幽灵乌鸦得到得+2攻击和+2躲避直到调查阶段结束。
cards.textEn:
Prey - Lowest [intellect].
Alert. Hunter. Retaliate.
Forced - After Spectral Raven engages you: You must either resolve each haunted ability on your location, or Spectral Raven gets +2 fight and +2 evade until the end of the investigation phase.

cards.name: Eager for Death
cards.text: 显现 - 检定[willpower](2)。你每有1点伤害，本次技能检定难度提升1点。如果你检定失败，受到2点恐惧。
cards.textEn: Revelation - Test [willpower] (2). Increase this skill test's difficulty by 1 for each damage on you. If you fail, take 2 horror.

cards.name: Psychopomp's Song
cards.text:
涌动。险境。
显现 - 将灵魂之歌加入到任意调查员的威胁区域。
强制 - 在你将要受到伤害时：受到额外2点伤害并弃掉灵魂之歌。
cards.textEn:
Surge. Peril.
Revelation - Add Psychopomp's Song to any investigator's threat area.
Forced - When you would take 1 or more damage: Take 2 additional damage and discard Psychopomp's Song.

cards.name: Death Approaches
cards.text:
涌动。险境。
显现 - 将死期临近加入到任意调查员的威胁区域。
强制 - 在你将要受到至少1点恐惧时：受到额外2点恐惧，弃掉死期临近。
cards.textEn:
Surge. Peril.
Revelation - Add Death Approaches to any investigator's threat area.
Forced - When you would take 1 or more horror: Take 2 additional horror and discard Death Approaches.

cards.name: Marked for Death
cards.text: 显现 - 检定[agility](2)。你身上每有1点恐惧，本次技能检定难度提升1点。如果你检定失败，受到2点伤害。
cards.textEn: Revelation - Test [agility] (2). Increase this skill test's difficulty by 1 for each horror on you. If you fail, take 2 damage.

cards.name: Watcher's Gaze
cards.text: 显现 - 每位调查员检定[willpower](5)。每位检定失败的调查员必须结算其所在地点的闹鬼能力，或结算幽灵看守人所在地点的闹鬼能力。
cards.textEn: Revelation - Each investigator tests [willpower] (5). Each investigator who fails must resolve either the haunted ability on his or her location, or the haunted ability on The Spectral Watcher's location.

cards.name: Diabolic Voices
cards.text: 显现 - 检定[willpower](3)。你检定失败且每低于难度1点，随机弃掉一张手牌。你每有一张卡牌无法弃掉，受到1点恐惧或1点伤害。遭遇弃牌中每有1张恶魔之音，本次检定难度+1。
cards.textEn: Revelation - Test [willpower] (3). For each point you fail by, discard 1 random card from your hand. For each card you cannot discard, take 1 horror or 1 damage. This test gets +1 difficulty for each copy of Diabolic Voices in the encounter discard pile.

cards.name: Wracked
cards.text:
显现 - 将崩毁离析放置入场，放到你的威胁区域。
每轮你执行的第一次技能检定期间，你得到每项技能值-1。
[action]：检定[willpower](3)。如果你检定成功，弃掉崩毁离析。如果你所在地点有处于横置状态的[[女巫]]敌人，本次检定自动成功。
cards.textEn:
Revelation - Put Wracked into play in your threat area.
You get -1 to each of your skills during the first skill test you perform each round.
[action]: Test [willpower] (3). If you succeed, discard Wracked. If there is an exhausted [[Witch]] enemy at your location, this test is automatically successful.

cards.name: Bedeviled
cards.text:
显现 - 将苦痛折磨放置入场，放到你的威胁区域。
你不能触发你控制的卡牌上的[action]能力。
[action]：检定[willpower](3)。如果你检定成功，弃掉苦痛折磨。如果你所在地点有处于横置状态的[[女巫]]敌人，本次检定自动成功。
cards.textEn:
Revelation - Put Bedeviled into play in your threat area.
You cannot trigger [action] abilities on cards you control.
[action]: Test [willpower] (3). If you succeed, discard Bedeviled. If there is an exhausted [[Witch]] enemy at your location, this test is automatically successful.
